entries.m: 释迦牟尼佛顶化佛 / 大白伞盖佛母 (usnisa-sitatapatra) 唐·中天竺沙门般剌蜜帝 译 / 唐·不空 译《大白伞盖陀罗尼经》 《大佛顶如来密因修证了义诸菩萨万行首楞严经》卷七 (t19n0945) 暨 gretil 梵本《sitatapatra》(bsu004_u.htm) 「咒中之王」大佛顶首楞严神咒五会全本核心(第一会毗卢真法会、第二会释尊应化会、第三会观音合同会、第四会金刚藏折摄会、第五会文殊弘传会暨五大心咒与根本咒心)。佛顶放百宝无畏光明,光中化佛宣说此咒,十方如来依此咒心成无上正遍知觉、降伏诸魔、制诸外道、拔济阿难免摩登伽难。直接对勘 cbeta《t19n0945.xml》卷七、房山石经《f28n1071》与德国哥廷根大学 gretil 梵文原典《bsu004_u.htm (sitatapatra)》。

entries.m: 药王菩萨 · 勇施菩萨 · 毗沙门天王 · 持国天王 · 鬼子母与十罗刹女 · 普贤菩萨 (姚秦)鸠摩罗什 译 · 梵本《saddharmapundarikasutra》(kern-nanjio / vaidya 校勘本)逐句对勘 《妙法莲华经》卷七〈陀罗尼品第二十六〉&〈普贤菩萨劝发品第二十八〉(t09n0262) / gretil bsu028pu.htm 《法华经》中最著名的六道护法总持。经载若有人侵毁法华受持法师,即为侵毁过去、现在八百千万亿那由他诸佛。药王菩萨、勇施菩萨、毗沙门天王、持国天王、十罗刹女及普贤菩萨依次宣说此六番陀罗尼,守护读诵大乘经典者百由旬内无诸衰患。

entries.m: 耆那五圣尊(阿罗汉·悉达·阿阇梨·亲教师·一切圣僧)· 瑜伽祖师帕坦伽利 (patanjali) 大雄尊者(mahavira)传承圣众 · 乌玛斯瓦蒂《谛义证得经》与帕坦伽利传统 耆那教《六分阿笈摩》开篇根本咒 ·《谛义证得经(tattvarthasutra)》·《上师歌(guru-gita)》 完整收录印度沙门传统另一瑰宝——耆那教(jainism)跨越两千五百年之最高根本圣咒《五敬礼真言(panca-namaskara / namokara mantra)》(梵文标准本与俗语古音本对勘,不求世间神祇恩宠而纯粹礼敬五阶解脱觉者之清净德行),并附印度全宗派共通之《上师礼赞咒(gurur brahma)》及全球瑜伽行者课前必诵之《帕坦伽利祈请颂》。 【常用检索别称:耆那教五敬礼咒,那摩卡拉真言,五尊礼赞咒,不害最高法印,上师三宝梵赞,帕坦伽利瑜伽经开篇祈请颂,namokar mantra,navkar mantra,panca namaskara,gurur brahma,yogena cittasya】

ni aaa aaa vili malia tani valibha li bhadhivi dhivili 那奢尼 婆陀 尼 蚩真兜 蚩真兜毗梨 摩梨呵多尼 跋梨婆梨

dhidhira ani naama he sabhara liabha ma huni apayam mahuni 婆汦 地地罗蛇尼 那无摩 醯 奢婆罗 梨师婆摩 呼尼
karabha dhi hudhibha dhi sumabha a sumabha ravi ahu taatha 坡波阎 摩呼尼 迦罗婆地 呼地婆地 蘇摩婆汦 蘇摩婆罗鞞
ara ara ara iama bhaca bhaghabha aa kaata aana alija 莎呼 多絰他 呵罗 呵罗 唏啰 伊大摩婆遮 婆伽婆
bhani kaghaa ni atada ani aghavi luani asabha a hubhabha 莎呵 迦緻多 阿㝹那 阿梨闍婆尼 迦伽大 尼 阿多荼呵尼
a aria ri athaa athari ni a thapara ca athabha 朱伽毗 卢呵尼 休娑婆汦 呼婆婆汦 唏利唏利 蛇他時 蛇他利尼
yam athabha a atha ari 蛇 他波囒遮 蛇他婆炎 蛇他婆嵐 蛇他 希利耽 莎呵」

v: nadea sammalo a arasu maamim iana caaca ni nabhaa cani 「那提阿三摩路卑 咩罗素摩𭒂泯 伊希那 遮久遮尼 那婆久遮尼

haraa haraa arara arara ma aabha adaa a ghaami aa 邏訶波履婆隸 麼那揭邏醯麼娜揭邏訶 波履婆隸 馺跛曷利捨揭邏醯馺跛曷利 捨揭邏訶波履婆隸 鞞䫂娜揭邏醯鞞䫂 娜揭邏訶波履婆隸
gaama paabha le caaga aheca agaa hapaa bhale surota ragaa 怛履瑟那揭罗醯怛 履瑟那揭罗訶波履婆隸 憂波陀那揭邏醯 憂波陀那揭邏訶波履婆隸 婆𭒂揭邏醯 婆𭒂揭邏訶波履婆隸 闍帝揭邏醯闍帝
hesu rotara gaaha paabha le gharada gaahe gharada gaaha paabha 揭邏訶波履婆隸 社啰摩啰娜揭邏醯社 啰摩啰娜揭邏訶波履婆隸 獨佉珊多跛 揭邏醯獨佉珊多跛揭邏訶波履婆隸 阿 啰波啰蹋陛社揭邏醯阿啰波啰蹋陛社揭邏
le abhaga ahea bhagaa hapaa bhale kayaga aheka 訶波履婆隸 阿跋䫂鞞婆䫂寫 阿跋啰 摸跛麼婆卸鞞也 毗尼跋䫂 阿利 耶曷啰捨弥 萨鞞伽羶帝莎波訶」

ce budhivi budhi mahabudhi anuma de anuma a paati adhani 漚制 蘇楼漚制 佛地毗佛地 摩訶佛地 欝奴摩提 欝奴摩爹

aara ja a haavi maaha race haaa a haaca te 訶䫂毗三麼揭离 訶䫂三姥爹啰社 裨 訶䫂鞞麼䫂曷啰誓 訶䫂咥㖑
haadha mahara ce haaa huhara ce haava jamate haaa ghahara 訶䫂者帝 訶䫂達麼曷啰誓 訶䫂蒱呼曷啰誓 訶䫂跋社麼帝 訶䫂噓伽曷啰捨弥 訶䫂達麼徙蜜帝

v: taatha dumate dumate ahadu mate parasa bhaduma te sarva kasadu 「怛絰他 头摩帝头摩帝 恶踦头摩帝 钵啰娑婆头摩帝 萨婆迦舍头摩帝

siakha gha vitia khagha aama khagha arakha gha ahakha gha 毗底寐却伽 郁芻麼却伽 嗚啰却伽 恶敧却伽 耶婆 麼娜却伽
yabha madakha gha aapa khagha yabhavi nanakha gha caada tokhagha 尤嘍跛却伽 耶婆毗娘那却 伽 斫芻陀妬却伽 耶婆麼娜毗娘那陀
yabhama davina nada tokhagha aria bhedato khagha yabhavi nadada tokhagha 妬却伽 必利洟陛陀妬却伽 耶婆毗 娘娜陀妬却伽 靼埵履悉蜜駐跛 萨他娜却伽
aaa simia pa sathada khagha yabhaa stadha saavi nika budadha 耶婆阿瑟吒達奢阿鞞尼迦 佛陀達摩却伽 獨佉却伽 耶婆磨勒 却伽
makhagha akhakha gha yabhama a khagha vibhaa davia a anada 毗婆𭒂娜毗敧𭒂 阿那娜娜 阿陛娜娜 三姥陀剆娜娜 萨婆迦啰 啰娜娜
da abheda da samada adada sarva kara ra 萨婆僧萨他娜毗瞿跛娜娜 阿緊柘若娜娜 叉婆叉婆 伊犁伊儸 伊犁伊罗 寐利蘇波呵」

bhiviya ya saa viyaya dhamavi yaya aavi yaya aluka viyaya 瞿沙毗夜也 緊柘那毗夜也 阿鼻三麼夜毗夜也 阿怒娜 阿奴娜 阿𭒂呵者者 者遮啰 者遮啰毗姥 柘陛斫芻者遮啰毗姥
parate bhadavi yaya pa ratesu lutaka viyaya ghaghana viyaya maaa 毗夜也毗 姥 察夜毗姥 阿磨毗夜也毗姥 阿 三姥阿遮啰毗姥 塢眵陀毗姥 阿迦 舍毗姥

kaya kara maksabha manau jaksabha aluka jnanaksa bha vijasam kamaksa 拏帝闍叉婆 什婆婆喻叉婆 迦耶 羯罗 摩叉婆 摩那乌闍叉婆

ksaya rasaksa bha katabhi yabhaksa bha yaya na nenatu na 舍摩迦闍叉婆 叉耶 啰娑叉婆 羯哆鼻耶婆叉婆 耶耶 那
abhane natuna naya panaa natuna isai bhatudhu aaa a 泥那都那 阿婆泥那都那 那耶 波那夷那都那 伊沙伊婆都度呿𡃂莎呵 」

jaa sarira guaya avia bhanaku a sadanku te sibhadan naa 毗哆钵啰鼻利 低 嘔波羯啰磨那梯 阿那比地夜跋 罗仚 钵罗帝羯迷那
vitapa rabhiri te apaka ramana a anapi dhiyava raa parate 三迦太夜世 萨卢遮那婆迷拘嚧太梨 迦摩萨世 阿世奢佉岐 那夜军闍 鼻地夜跋
kamena samkaa yaa saluca nabhame kuroa li kamasa a aasa 泥 羯罗那跋泥 欝遮跋泥 三迷摩迦 梨
khagi nayakun ja bhidhiya va ne karana vane acava ne 奢利夜跋泥 摸伽闍师 呵利拘 那婆 那夜那目仚 娑啰叉拘梨
sammema ka li sariya vane aghaja a ariku nabha nayana 那 罗延拏樹梨 因陀罗婆萨泥 乌阿 阿婆阿 阿阿何罗婆阿婆啰
mu 阿 婆啰 阿罗萨弥伽 豆佉禰提啰 涅槃醯 莎和呵」

asamvi tani a aaa acara ani nibhesa ni aksa vini 阿 卑靺嚟 拔折啰珊儞 涅陛設儞 阿乞芻
asamks avini akssa ya a ayaa kssaya apayam te aksa 毗儞 阿僧乞芻毗儞 阿乞沙耶 阿 避夜已
nakssa yamtasa aaa apari kssa ye aviks aani aviga a 乞沙耶阿钵演帝 阿乞师 那乞沙演多萨姪里世 阿钵唎乞沙 曳

v: viaa viara nusahi te paranu ni niana viara ni aviya 「毗筏嚟 毗筏啰弩娑呬諦 钵啰弩儞 儞珊那尾筏啰尼 阿毗夜筏迦賖珊 㮈設儞 钵啰皤嚟
akaa a asani paraa a paraa ramisu dhani nivika vi 钵啰皤啰弭輸 達儞 涅毗羯鞞 阿迦賖三摩筏娑啰 尼 儞省霓 省伽波揭底 省伽
akaa sammaa sara ni niage aghapa gati agha vimuca ni 毗牟折儞 阿娜驮儞 阿驮曩毗揭 帝 薑乞沙掣那钵唎羯麼 遏掣泥 阿弩钵掣泥 阿三冥
adadha ni adhana viga te akssa anapa rikama aane anupa 地毗耶 若 曩阿呵啰寧 钵啰攘斫芻毗輸驮儞 設黎耶播那耶儞 地孕祇乌怛啰 尼 阿喻雞
ane asama dhiviya jna naaa rane paraa caavi sudhani saaya 阿毗喻雞 阿三钵啰 喻雞 阿毗钵啰喻雞 阿紇啰钵 驮涅賀嚟 涅提賖钵驮毗輸達儞 阿底
tpanaya ni dhiyagi utara ni ayoke aviyo ke asampa ra 多那揭多钵啰底逾般那毗輸達儞 訖 唎多钵唎羯麼毗儞諦 曩多啰他 弩揭諦 阿僧羯啰冥 阿訖啰钵驮毗 輸達儞
yoke avipa rayoke aara pa dhaniha a nidea padhavi sudhani 钵驮钵啰陛驮攘那毗輸達儞 涅皤斯 阿皤婆毗輸達儞 三漫 多㮈賖地賖毗耶筏卢羯寧 弭啰瘧 钵驮涅訶嚟 钵啰若弭輸地
ati tanaga tapara tiapa navisu dhani a ritapa rikama vinite 嗚皤 娑阿钵啰冥迦啰尼 阿矩罗波達摩 㮈唎設那弭輸達儞 步多遏啰他珊 㮈唎設儞 阿怒耄驮遏他弭輸誕儞 娑竭啰質多弩钵啰吠世
natara tha nugate asamka raa aara padhavi su 謎嚧钵唎僧 萨他寧 啰湿弭钵啰多钵儞 萨 婆路迦地钵帝耶攘囊尾輸誕儞 阿钵 啰底褐多 阿僧伽攘那㮈唎設寧」

v: maapa ti masumam ti nebhaa rajna saapa ti sarva asura 「麼棄钵底 麼蘇莽底 泥婆阿啰若 舍至钵底 萨婆阿蘇啰曩 涅罗伽多 儞 未而曬野 素钵啰底瑟恥多 钵 啰莽阿啰娜怒比 阿素啰喃 泥嚩 南阿地钵碪 萨 那布啰塞仡唎 覩呬涅
na niragha ta ni maasai ya supara tisthi ta pa 泥微呬庶皤細 嚩娑嚩 萨那 布爛㮈啰 都 多閉肆 阿素 啰萨那 墮喏阿䞘林 多嚩钵施 埵 微圖孕肆多 麼訶素啰 阿素 麗那啰钵啰演底 避多啰悉多 那輸地賒
ramama radadu pi asura nam neva namadhi paa sa napura 那莽勃陀肆也 已曷底 使曳 曩麼狱多啰 摩訶野舍 泥嚩阿素啰肆酩 僧孽啰名 勃陀 摄陀 阿耨多啰 室啰末斯 泥嚩 微誓耶 那麼勃陀底曩莽斯 僧 羯啰麼闡那斯末捻 勃陀囊銘曩
sari ntuhini nevihi aase vasva sana puaa ra tu taasi 嚩呬多 微誓曳素 多多泥嚩 阿素啰 室者 微寧多𭊃 訖里多帝 啰 乞沙泥嚩南 麼努沙南 啰乞沙 三尾那 曳翳訶 達麼儞泥世 污 多囒底 素钵啰底瑟恥多
asu rasana aaa aa tavapa a a viaya sita mahasu 寧疙里呬多 多嚩夜阿素啰 阿啰 去灑娑药叉緊那啰 曩伽鳩盤吒 步多儞 毗舍遮那曩嚩多他 阿者 罗悉他曩 钵啰钵覩肆 印那啰 印那啰 布啰塞訖里多 阿底严 毗啰 扇旦者 阿孽啰布𡀔沙
ra asu anara parayam ti atara sita nasudhi sa namambhr 細尾囊 钵啰攘漫覩肆 泥末 那啰 勃地麼多他微庶路多 阿 末捨翳訶 素多啰肆氏 阿啰乞 沙三末娜呬多 娑訶萨啰泥多啰 素目佉罨播娑麗 钵唎嚩履多 污波悶攘萨嚩甘羯忙 布啰迷呬 覩肆銘 野訖唎檐
dasiya ahati dibira ye namaa tara mahayasa nevaa surasi a 阿底钵始遮 阿努钵啰沒多 阿者罗素钵唎底瑟 恥多 訖里膽呬 據舍藍布啰迷 麼怒世數 忙呬钵底 布啰嚩虚 牟肆 泥嚩南 布𡂉印底 答嚩忙 努沙 勃陀肆野訖唎得嚩 萨得 迦藍
samgara a bhrda sada aduhta ra sirama si neva viceya 布闍陛殺底 帝莫呼 摩訶 嚩莽寧 微者藍皤嚩南者 素庶皤 底 泥嚩來野肆 莽地野肆氏 野 去疏呬 播履嚩履覩 钵啰灆磨 呵唎磨𤙖者 多嚩肆迦 微舍那阿疙啰 嚩呬
namabhr datina mamsi sam karama anasi madi bhrdaa mena vahita 娑哆底麼底 素啰多钵啰 底 娑啰多娑多他 钵啰部萨建陀 阿儞啰者莽啰者 摩訶磨霓 摩訶 萨建陀 摩訶計都 素钵啰地者 摩訶磨啰 翳帝药叉 摩訶帝喏 阿啰乞羼底皤嚩南多嚩 摩护药叉钵 唎嚩𡀔
viceye su 曳那輸皤肆嚩娑嚩 摩素 萨嚩嚩素底喏 摩訶帝喏摩訶仰儞 摩 訶钵啰訶啰怒制嚩 阿尾呬娑那耶 多替嚩者 素名嚧暮啰陀儞 多嚩嚩娑嚩 萨嚩泥嚩 布啰塞訖 唎覩 庶婆底 婆嚩曩污婆 娑 钵啰磨悶者肆 底喏娑」

cani paramu caava ti arita ari tavati aduna a aduna 嚩底 微步底 微步多嚩底 钵啰牟 折儞
mamvati utpa taada ni ghamavi vaani tiris na samua sani 钵啰牟折囊嚩底 訖唎多訖唎 多嚩底 阿怒仰酩 阿怒仰莽嚩底

v: adhipa ti mahasitha naati sva yamari ta sithana ati nanama 「阿地钵底 摩訶悉他曩筏底 娑嚩 琰訖唎多 悉他曩酩底
huvi vidha parati atpasa thanagha rana adhigha sathana pati adhasa 曩曩摩护微 尾驮 钵啰底與播萨他曩伽啰曩 阿地伽萨他曩钵底 庶驮萨他曩孽
thanaga ntu saapa ti adhika ata via dhana abhapa ri 覩 娑含钵底 阿地羯爛多 微庶 驮曩 庶婆钵唎
paraa adhimu ta para bhrtasi rita nivasa a parabhru ta 钵啰庶皤地目多 钵啰 勃多室唎多 儞嚩娑囊 钵啰步
paraa nigara atagha ma svasiti ghama parati atpasa tha na 多 钵啰皤 儞孽啰蹊多伽麼 娑嚩悉底伽麼 钵啰底與播萨他 曩」

v: visudha navati atima gharuni ghama mava usata ni parani atani 「微輸驮曩嚩底 案底麼伽嚕儞 伽麼 磨嚩 鄔娑多儞
pariyam ta parati apasi thanapa ya vasana aaya visudha ni 钵啰涅酩多儞 钵唎演多 钵啰底與波悉他曩钵耶 嚩娑曩 阿賴耶微輸驮儞

v: arona a acapa a svavini a ra komane niana parati 「愚嚧那嚟 阿者钵麗 娑嚩毗涅呵 啰 句末泥
viroa ne a taaca nani atapa rikaa atasam pa rasana 涅攘曩钵啰底微嚧異寧 只 多珊者曩儞 只多钵唎羯酩 只多三钵 啰娑那儞
ni manasi ya arisa ghara ni viana siya adusva ti 麼曩肆也 呵唎灑伽啰 儞 微攘曩肆也 阿怒娑嚩底
adudha manua gatasane hitua narisa ni tatha agatasa rapana ninesa 阿怒達 麼努閉去灑寧 呬都珊那唎舍儞 多他 阿去殺啰钵那 涅泥舍
sudhita va ti yathaga ta yathanu kolotpa ma u tpamamni 輸地多嚩 底 野他孽多 野他努句路播麼 鄔 播莽涅泥舍
nesa viadhi ta tatara gha a nacaka aviyam sampara sa 微庶地多 怛多啰伽 麗 曩者羯答微阎 三钵啰娑
daatha ntusama yathadu kolaca mukha upasam harayo nisa asaya siya 娜遏他覩娑麼 野他怒句嬾者目佉 鄔波僧賀啰喻儞舍 阿舍耶肆也 微庶地耶 野他庶地底
viadhi ya yathaa dhiti ragata sanara gatasani ragatasa navati ra 罗去 灑曩罗去灑儞 罗去灑曩嚩底 罗 去灑囊微輸驮儞
gatasaa visudha ni parati vedhaa tha anari sani kosara bothasa 钵啰底吠驮遏他 珊那唎舍儞 句舍啰冐他萨謎呵 钵 啰微者曳 娑麼娑啰儞
mea 訖唎多怒 阿啰去史 萨底也遏替 萨底 也南 素微輸地帝」

v: gatasame gatasama vati metara parika ma parati apasa thane ghakaa 「去灑迷 去灑麼嚩底 迷多啰钵唎羯 麼
pa ratia bha hitanu kampa samana ni samgara avasa ntu 钵啰底與波娑他寧 伽𡀔囊钵 啰底邏婆 呬多努剑跛 散喏曩儞
hitava santu samnara sani pariva aniya vaani apaa tara sevani 僧揭啰呵嚩萨覩 呬多嚩萨覩 散那啰 舍儞 钵唎嚩喏儞耶
naata ranea satha aviya yatara vigara avati du sa magaa 嚩喏儞 簸跛咩 多啰 細嚩儞 曩坦多啰泥世萨他
da parana ani upaa ra anari sani nisara yavia dhani 答微耶 野多啰尾揭啰呵嚩底怒 萨 摩孽爛陀 钵啰那邏儞
a tamadu ghaa parau pasama rani niata ni adura gatasa 鄔波蔗啰 珊那唎舍儞 儞舍啰夜微庶驮儞 阿 多麼怒伽酩
parati apasa thane 钵啰鄔波僧呵啰儞 涅酩多儞 阿怒啰去沙 钵啰底 與波娑他寧」

v: tadyatha ariye ariya vati ari yaduga te nidhane nidhana vati 「怛姪他阿唎曳 阿唎耶嚩底 阿唎 耶怒揭帝
va ntupara a varantu aana gharani aghasa visudha ni adugata 儞驮寧 儞驮曩嚩底 嚩 覩钵啰酩 嚩啰覩簸掣那伽啰儞
aani anegata aani aviga tapara a adu tpagati ni nimbhana 阿伽舍微輸驮儞 阿怒去鎩簸儞 阿寧去鎩簸儞 阿微孽多钵啰酩
pathavi sudhani vi yapani gatasipa ti adutpa na neka dhatpara 阿怒 播孽底儞 涅畔曩钵他微輸驮儞 微 耶波儞去史钵底
a sarva animbha nanena rasa ne 阿怒播那 寧𡀔 驮播啰酩 萨嚩攘涅畔曩寧那啰舍 寧」

v: tadhiya thaama li aama li aa mali ajabha bha ajabha 「多地也他阿摩离 阿𩢨麼离 阿𩢨 麼离
bha arasa li viyakha sali jamasa li aaa aaa gurasa 阿闍婆婆 阿闍婆婆 茂啰沙离 鞞夜佉娑离 社麼娑离
ta janaa gha jiyaa gha a jiyabha saagha aaksa ra 呵呵呵呵呵呵 瞿啰娑吒 社那呿伽 爾也呿伽 泌
ksaksaksa ksaksaksa arabha a aghasa bhaajna sabhapa a pataa ra 爾也婆娑呿伽 阿茂叉啰 叉叉叉叉叉叉 茂啰婆呵 呿伽娑婆呿若
ajnajna bhayujna adara aaya jnajna nabhajna jna araksa jna jna 娑婆跛履 跛哆茂啰 阿若若婆由若 氈陀啰
bhabhajna jna atako atatha tajna jna sarva jiara dhisithi tajnajna 嗽履也若若 那婆若若 丘啰叉若 若 婆婆若若
bhakara ma tiaghan taksabha ksamama ksa majna a upara tamara 倍哆句胝哆他多若 若 萨婆爾脾啰地史恥多若若 婆迦啰麼 底履健哆叉婆
viaya sabha a 叉麼摩叉 摩若 差上哆摩啰毗所也 娑婆 呵」

v: tadhiya thaama ama dhamadha ma ama ama niada daranu ranira 「多地也他豆摩豆摩 駄摩駄摩 豆摩 豆摩 儞履娜
kutani ku tani mahakuta ne tatata a mahatata abhasa avia 娜罗努罗儞罗 鳩吒儞鳩 吒儞 摩訶鳩吒泥 吒吒吒株 摩訶吒吒
vi ania ni mahaani ani amia miami daami aama haaa 阿婆娑 阿毗阿毗 履尼履尼 摩訶履尼 履尼 履弭履弭履弭
aaa a mahaaa aa aa aada mahaaa aa asalama salama 陀履弥 履簁摩 訶履簁 首楼首楼 摩訶首楼首楼 首楼
sala mana amia mi heahe a heahe a heahe a 首楼陀 摩訶首楼首楼 嘔舅摩舅摩 舅 摩那 履弭履弭
heahe a hea ni minimi henihe ni munimu ni bhudhi 醯履醯履 醯履醯 履 醯履醯履 醯履醯履 醯履
apara bhara ataa talo ka aaya jineji ne jidaa abha 儞 弭儞弭 醯儞醯儞 母儞母儞 部地 履跛啰婆啰

adaa abha aa akara dana atadan a ataa ta ati 歷娜履所婆 朽朽 阿迦啰檀池 阿哆檀池 阿哆阿 哆
ata heni heni heahe ahea heahe ahea hea tatara salaa 阿底 嘔吒 醯儞 醯儞 醯履醯 履醯履醯履醯履醯履醯履

ataa ta ata arana mikha ksabhakha pi adhivi apa tesu 呵吒呵吒 呵吒 阿啰拏弥佉 叉婆佉 比 履地毗
bhayu akasa aada aa aaa ah aaa jiabha aasa aghaa 阿跛 帝殊 婆由 阿迦捨 𭈪𭈪陀窮脾 朋窮脾
a raaa a sadasa aaa sabhaa 恶 差窮脾 視許婆窮脾萨傍伽窮脾 啰袪窮脾 娑陀娑斗窮脾 娑婆呵 」

v: aatha siasi a susia mocani muksa ni mutevi mute amaa 「『呾姪他悉𬀹悉𬀹 蘇悉𬀹 谟折儞木剎 儞 目帝毗目帝
vimaa agaa hiajna gaviha raada gavi sarva athasa ani parama 菴末麗毗末麗 忙揭例 呬㘓若揭鞞曷喇呾娜 揭鞞 萨婆頞他娑 但儞
atha saani madase maha madase abhrute asibhru te vitabha ye 钵啰摩頞他 娑但儞末捺細 莫訶 末捺細 頞步帝頞室步帝 毗多婆曳
suvane varaa ma guakha varaa matyua te sarva athesu apara 蘇跋泥 跋啰蚶摩 瞿俠佉 跋啰蚶 摩柱俠帝
atesa vaara apaa tiate cantusa sa bhrdakoti bhaate dumasa bha 萨婆頞剃數 阿钵啰匝帝萨 跋呾啰 阿钵𭈗底𠿒帝 折覩殺 瑟㮹
atha gatanam svaha 勃陀俱胝 婆俠帝 纳摩娑婆 呾他 揭多喃 莎訶』」

v: aatha gumegu meani menihi ma timati aata thagata sammadhi ades 「但姪他 具謎具謎𧫦尼謎膩呬 末 底末底
thite atema tepaa papasu ani sarva papana aya aabhr a 馺䫂怛他揭多三摩地頞提瑟恥帝 頞帝末帝波例 波跛輸但儞 萨婆波跛那
aame ameku me bu dhaata ra paasu anidham meadham me 世也 㪍睇勃圖 唱答謎隖謎矩謎 佛 鐸器怛罗
meru meru merosi khale sarva ara mirntu nibhaa ni bhrdesu 钵里輸但儞曇謎昵曇謎 謎嚕 謎嚕 謎嚧尸朅囇萨婆哥罗
bhra budada ade schane dahaca ksantume sarva debha sammea sammesam 蜜栗覩 尼婆𡃤儞 勃提蘇勃睇 佛陀陀頞提 瑟侘泥娜曷𠸪叉覩謎
manaa antume sarva budabo desa a samesa me paraa meman 萨婆提婆 三謎頞 三謎三曼捼漢㘓覩謎萨婆佛陀菩提萨 埵
ntume sa bhaiti apadha bha sarva viaa ya sarva saa 苫謎苫謎 钵喇苦謎曼 覩謎 萨 婆伊底隖波達婆萨婆毗何大也
namcapo anepo anepo ayame sa bhaasa aaa ya pariti bhase 萨婆萨埵 难者晡㘓泥晡㘓泥晡㘓也謎 萨 婆阿舍
sarva papa aaka le svaha 薜琉璃也 钵唎底婆細 萨婆 波跛 著楊羯囇莎訶」

entries.m: धारणीसंग्रहः (65) 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (dsbc) digital sanskrit buddhist canon (dsbc) dharani samgraha §65 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (dsbc)」《陀罗尼集 (dharani samgraha)》第 65 品(罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行)。跋文:sarasvatamsarthipibe sma ptabhimantritam || caturguna ajaksire ghrtamasyam vipacayet || jaisa'dhopari kamatramsanaimrhyabhivasudhih | masamatraprabhum jitavarnim prapnosvanastaram || sanmasaprayogena saksadvagisvaro bhavet || rutakokila nirghasah jayate bhadhura svarah | samsayane hukartyavyasucinta bhavah saktayah || itisri sarasvati namadharani pari samaptah || 100 || om namah scarmmapunulikayai || om vajascanta ah om rana'parana' samprarana' sarvva buddha pracarini prajnaparamita nadasvabhavah sattosana karaya hum phat svaha || saddharma tharundhremamdha nthovadana sampanno manunadayanyu。 dharanisamgrahah (65) 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (dhsbhch) dhigital sanskrit bhuddhist chanon (dhsbhch) dhharani samgraha §65 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (dhsbhch)」《陀罗尼集 (dhharani samgraha)》第 65 品(罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行)。跋文:sarasvatamsarthipibe sma ptabhimantritam || caturguna ajaksire ghrtamasyam vipacayet || jaisa'dhopari kamatramsanaimrhyabhivasudhih | masamatraprabhum jitavarnim prapnosvanastaram || sanmasaprayogena saksadvagisvaro bhavet || rutakokila nirghasah jayate bhadhura svarah | samsayane hukartyavyasucinta bhavah saktayah || itisri sarasvati namadharani pari samaptah || 100 || om namah scarmmapunulikayai || om vajascanta ah om rana'parana' samprarana' sarvva buddha pracarini prajnaparamita nadasvabhavah sattosana karaya hum phat svaha || saddharma tharundhremamdha nthovadana sampanno manunadayanyu。

om , o lotus holder who grants unfailing victory! curu curu , svaha !
om , o holder of a lotus noose who grants amogha boons! arouse the buddhas, hum !
om , o lotus-armed one who holds the great noose! i invite you, one of unfailing power, to come to earth! muru muru , hum !
om , padmamogha, get on, get on with vajra-securing the ground! svaha !
om , the throne of amoghapasa upon lotuses! oti , miri miri , hum !
om , great compassionate amoghapasa! you are founded upon a firm vajra! bhuru bhuru , in this best of places, svaha !
om , amogha mandala! secure the borders all around with lotuses and great lotuses! dhuru dhuru , svaha !
om , amogha purity! purify the entire area! dhiri dhiri ! o pure being! o great lotus! hum !
om , flow within the lotus, flow! remain, remain! o great amogha samaya! svaha !
om , great lotus, amogha-expand! may he enter! act, act, svaha !
om , amogha-settle within the circumference of the great lotus, hum !
om , amogha lotus in the topknot! turu turu ! remain in the vajra knot, svaha !
om , toss the lotus water of amogha ! bhiri bhiri , hum !
om , amogha deformed water-container on a lotus seat! full of water! act, act, hum !
om , amogha purity within the expanse of the lotus! carry, carry, svaha !
om , amogha lotus, the auspicious pure lotus that brings fulfillment! viri viri , svaha !
om , fragrant amogha ! suru suru , prabhuru ! divine fragrance with the glow of a lotus! svaha !
phat
om , you with amogha lotus eyes and divine vision, completely pure! suru suru ! o lotus-eyed one, bhuru bhuru ! you direct your gaze everywhere! svaha !
om , wake up, wake up! wake up lucidly, facing padmamogha! choose, choose any boon! svaha !
om , holder of the amogha treasury! unfold, expand, hum !
om , amogha garments! muru muri ! become divinely soft! tara tara , svaha !
om , amogha clothes! i cast off clothes within the lotus that brings awakening, svaha !
om , collecting the rainwater, you flow along the amogha banks! consecrate! hum !
om , amogha lotus seat of nectar, raining down! curu curu , svaha !
om , amogha protection! take effect, do!
om , amogha samaya! remain within the great lotus, hum !
om , you who never fail in any way! remain and protect, hum !
om , you who overstep the three worlds with amogha lotus steps! mili mili , svaha !

v: kayaviveke sthitva alikalidvarena vagviveke 'vatarati | yada vajrajapakramena pranayamam adhigato bhavati tada vagvajra- samadhau pratisthito bhavati | vagviveke sthitva prakrtyabhasakramena cittaviveke 'vatarati | yada prakrtyabhasam vayuvahanaprabhedam yathabhutam siksate tada cittavajrasamadhisamapanno bhavati | cittasya yathabhutaparijnane sthitva dvadasamayadrstantena samvrtisatye 'vatarati | yada mayopamasamadhisamapanno bhavati tada sarvabuddhabhisekam pratilabhate | mayopamasamadhau sthitvastadasamahasunyatanukramena paramarthasatye 'vatarati | yada pindagrahanubhedasamadhina bhutakotim pravisati tada sarvaklesavisuddho bhavati | yada jnanakramena vyutthaya prakrtiprabhasvaram satyadvayadvaidhikarenatmanam abhisambudhyati tada nispannakramasamadhau siksito bhavati

vajrasisya uvaca | kayavivekasiksayam apagatasamsayah | katham bhagavan vagviveke siksitavyam katham pratipattavyam | bruhi bhagavan vajraguruh sasta | guhyasamaja vagviveka / mantratattva: kaya vak citta / kayavakcitta, tryaksara vajrajapa om ah hum

vajragurur aha | sadhu sadhu mahasattva | skandhadhatvayatanadyanantaroktakayavivekas tatra devatavinyasas ca sarvesam sadharanam sthulayogatvat | vagvivekas tu yogijnanam atisuksmam mahayanikanam avisayah | vajrayanikanam apy utpattikramacarinam agocarah suksmayogatvat | tasmad yatnatah srnv aham te vistarena vyakhyatantranusarena vagvajrasamadhim pratibodhayami

tatra kulah satavidhah prokta ityadipurvoktasutram kayavakcittavivekasyapi sadharanam | tatra vagviveko nama mantratattvam | tac ca vayutattvanupurvena vina na jnayate | vayutattvam nama pranayamah | ato vayutattvasyoddesapadam sriguhyasamajad avataryate
pancavarnam maharatnam sarsapasthulamatrakam
nasikagre prayatnena bhavayed yogatah sadeti
idam vajrapadam neyanitarthabhedena dvividhadevatayogasyapi yujyate | tatrotpattikramabhavako nasagre sarsapaphalapramanam svadevatacihnam svacittadrdhikaranartham bhavayed iti suksmayogavyapadesah

anenaiva nispannakramasamadhisamagatanam suksmayogam aha | alikalibhih stripunnapumsakarupena tryaksaram nispadya | aksaratrayam api pravesasthitivyutthane niyojya caturmandalakramena pranayamatmakam vajrajapam kuryad iti
imam artham dyotayann aha
pancajnanamayam svasam pancabhutasvabhavakam
niscarya padmanasagre pindarupena kalpayet
pancavarnam maharatnam pranayamam iti smrtam
ity uktam samajottare
esam uddesapadanam nirdesam aha | sandhyavyakaranasamajavyakhyatantre
atha bhagavan mahavajri vajrajaparthabhasinam
pratyuvaca tatah samyak pranamyaikam jagadgurum
laukikagamam evedam bodhicittam prakasitam
lokottaram katham nama pratipatsyanty agamikah
sarvadrstiprahanaya tvaya dharmo hi desitah
tat katham bodhicittam tu sa drstih sudrdhikrta
uktam artham na budhyanti sandhyayavakyamohitah
yatharutam te grhnanti vadanti nanyatheti ca
atha bhagavan visvo vajrapanim vadet tatah
sadhu sadhu ca guhyesa vyakrta agamikas tvaya
bodhicittam bhaved vayur ambare ca vyavasthitah
pranabhutas ca sattvanam pancatma dasasanjnakah
pratityadvadasangakhyam svabhavat tritayam bhavet
sarvendriyapradhanedam vayvakhyam bodhicittakam
avyaktam suksmam ity evam vyaktam ity ucyate sada
tadasrayat tu karmani kuryad visayadikam janah
santikam paustikam caiva vasyabhicarukam tatha
bodhicittat tu tat sarvam tritattvanilayasraye
yavanto lokasanketah kalpita vividhas tatha
bhavanti bodhicittat tu vikalpa vayutah sada
sukhaduhkhadiko dharmo bijad eva vidhiyate
bodhicittasvabhavo 'sau skandhadyadvayakhopamah
prajnopayaikayogena bodhicittam jagad bhavet
svayam samuccaret svami dhyanadhyayanavarjitah
divaratrivibhagena candrasuryaprayogatah
nihsvaso hi jagadvyapi bodhicittaikamarutah
subhasubhaphalam tyaktva bhavaty eva nabhopama iti
vajrasisya uvaca | vayuh pancatma dasasanjnaka ity uktam | anukampam upadaya bruhi bhagavann ekaikasya vayoh sanjnantaram
vajragurur aha | anantarokta. vyakhyatantre naiva nirdistam tad darsayamah
atha bhagavan sarvatathagatan sarvabodhisattvams ca tathaiva ca pravisya tosanarthaya tathagatadhipater dasavayun aha
pranapanasamanakhyan udanavyanasanjnakan
nagakurmakrkarams ca devadattadhananjayan
krtvaitan atmano bimbam stritvam nirmayate punar iti
ete dasa vayavah srisarvabuddhasamayogadakinijalasamvara .naye yena yena rutenoktas tams tan apy aha
kotakhyah kotavah kotah kotabhas ca katirakah
kolakhyah kolavah kolah kolabhas ca kalis tatha
etani dasa namani vajramukhimahayogatantre 'pi yatharutarthena dasavayun praha | pranapanodanasamanavyanodvahavivahasamvahapravahanirvahas ceti
vajrasisya uvaca | pranadidasavayavo 'smin kaye kutra prativasanti | kim kurvanti ca bruhi bhagavan vajraguruh sasta
vajragurur aha | panca vayavah kayavibhage sthitva kayavyaparam kurvanti | panca vayavas caksuradyayatane sthitva indriyavyaparam kurvanti

tatra prano hrdistho 'ksobhyas tathagatah | apano gudastho ratnasambhavas tathagatah | udanah kanthastho 'mitabhas tathagatah | samano nabhistho 'moghasiddhis tathagatah | vyanah sarvasandhistho vairocanas tathagata iti | udvaho rupam | vivahah sabdah | samvaho gandhah | pravaho rasah | nirvahah sparsas ceti

ete dasa vayavah punar ucchvasaprasvasa bhavanti | te ca punar vayavyadicaturmandalatmaka bhavanti | te ca punas caturdevyatmaka bhavanti | te ca punah pancabhutatmaka bhavanti | te ca punar adarsadipancajnanatmaka bhavanti | te ca punah sitadipancarasmyatmaka bhavanti | te ca punah pancatathagatatmaka bhavanti | te ca punas tryaksaradharo bhutva pravesasthitivyutthanakramena vajrajapam karayanti | te ca punar vayavo 'karasyadharo bhutva asesavakpravyaharam karayanti | te ca punar anahatam vyapya nihsvabhava bhavanti
vajrasisya uvaca | katham bhagavann ete dasa vayava ekanekasvabhavena divaratrau svakaye spharanasamharanam kurvanti | bruhi bhagavan vajraguruh sasta
vajragurur aha | sadhu sadhu mahasattva sritattvasangraha dau mulatantre cottaratantre ca vayutattvam na vispastenoktam | sandhyayabhasitatvat | vyakhyatantre tu yatharutena bhasitam tad avataryate
nasikacchidrasambhutah pancabuddhakulasthitah
pancavayurdhvasancaro dehe carati nityasah
samvrtighranasancaro dvarat tasya vinihsrtah
vamadaksinadvandvas ca stabdhas caite caturvidhah
daksinat prasaro dhatur hutabhugmandalam ca vai
raktavarnam idam vyaktam padmanathasya sancaret
vamac ca prasaro dhatur vayumandalanihsrtah
haritasyamasankasam karmanathasya sancaret
dvandvasya prasaro dhatuh kanakavarnasannibhah
mahendramandalam caiva ratnanathasya sancaret
stabdho na prasaro dhatuh ksanad varunamandalam
suddhasphatikasankasam vajranathasya sancaret
sarvadhatun samuddhrtya hy adharadheyadharitah
vairocanamahakayo maranante viniscaret
caturmandalam etadd hi japen nityam samahitah
ahoratram sada japyo mantrinam japasankhyaya
ity uktam bhagavata vajramalamahayogatantre | asyayam arthah | vajrapadmayor nasikabhyam rasmim viniscaret | urdhvagatah samvrtinasagrad vamadaksinadvandvastabdhakramena niscarati

tatrayam kramah | vamaghranad vinirgato vayur amoghasiddhis tathagatah | vayusvabhavo vayavyamandalam haritasyamarasmisvarupam iti | daksinaghranat sancarito vayur amitabhas tathagatah | tejahsvabhavo 'gnimandalam raktarasmisvabhavam | ghranadvandvad vinirgato vayu ratnasambhavo mahendramandalam pitarasmisvabhavam | stabdho mandapracaro vayur aksobhyah | svacchabdhatusvabhavo varunamandalam svetarasmisvabhavam | catvari dhatumandalani vyano vyapto vayur na niscarati rasmih srivairocanas tathagatah khasamasvabhavah

kintv ekaiko rasmir viniscaret | pancapancarasmir vinirgacchati | ekena dhatumandalena catvaro dhatavo vyapta iti | ekaikasminn api mandale tryaksaramantradhipatih pravesadikramena svayam eva satatam japed iti | sanksepato vayutattvam uktam
vajrasisya uvaca | gurupadaprasadad vayutattvam agamadhigamabhyam susiksito 'ham | adhuna mantratattvasya laksanam jnatum icchami | anukampam upadaya nirdisatu bhagavan vajraguruh sasta

vajragurur aha | sadhu sadhu mahasattva mantratattvam nama tattvasangrahadau mulatantre cottaratantre ca kevalam mantramatram udiritam mantroddharo na pradarsitah | vyakhyatantre tu mantroddharo mantrasanketo mantrartho mantratattvam ca bhagavata sadbhavena vivrtam | ato vyakhyatantram anadhigata bahyamantraparayana na prajananti | tasmad yatnatah srnu vyakhyatantra nusarena mantratattvam te pratibodhayami

tatra sarpadimantra alikalisamudbhavah | tesam tattvam anahatodbhavam tryaksaram | yasmat sarvamantrah stripunnapumsakasvabhava yathalabdhopadesena tryaksare pravisanti | tena tryaksarah sarvamantradhipatih | te ca punar ekaikaso 'nahatena saha tribhis tribhir aksarair nispannah

adhuna 'ksaratrayasya vyaparo nirdisyate | tatra tavat trisamyogad devatamurtim nispadayati | sa eva pravesasthitivyutthanakramena deham aharnisam dharayati | sa evalikalibhih saha dvayendriyasamapattikale 'dhomukho bhutva guhyanasikacchidrac chukrarupena vinirgatya sattvadhatun utpadayati | sa eva pranayamena saha punar urdhvam gatva indriyadvaram prabodhya samvrtighrana- dvarad vamadaksinadikramena nirgatyanabhogena vajrajapam krtva purvakarmavaranam visodhayati | sa evahoratrakramena japasankhyam upalaksya varunadimandalodaye sitadivarnam asritya santikadisarvakarmani karoti | sa evaksararupena parikalpito nabhispanditajihvagretyadivagjapalaksanena japam krtva bahyavarnadikriyam asritya santikadisarvakarmani karoti | sa eva tryaksarasodhanabodhanajvalanakramenaharam visodhya niramayam karoti | evam kadevaravasthayam sarvam krtva paryante 'nahate pravisya punar api prakrtadeham asritya tathaiva sarvam karoti

svaravyanjanavarnas ca navasankhyanuvartinah
abaddhanyonyasamyogad yo vetti sa jagadguruh
yo buddhva vanchayet siddhim vimuktiphalasampadam
sa tad eva samapnoti arupad rupavarjitam
bhutantena samayuktam kaladisodase sthitam
pancapancakasamyuktam catustrayaniyojitam
sanusvaram sadirgham ca gunasamyogalopavat
hrasvam samastavakyam syan na canekam na caikakam
yakararthena yat kincit kartavyam siddhim icchata
rephaditritayenaiva jagatkaryam pravartate
ye varnah prsthatah prokta abhimukhas ca ye punah
stripunnapumsakas te ca dhatvadiparikalpitah
adhaurdhvasamayukta jnatva buddhya niyojitah
sadbhir uktam catustryaikan nihsvabhavaikabhavajam
tan yadyarthe samayojya tryadhvajnanam tu jayate
svapnendrajalavad vidvan kuryaj jagat tridhatuke
pravyaharam idam mantram nihsvabhavasvabhavajam
tatah parinatam rupam yad devatopalambhakam
sanketikam tritattvastham prakrtijapalaksanam
anakhyeyam anuccaryam bodhicittam idam param
tad eva tritayaikam syad anirgamam anagamam
anirodham prasantam ca sasvatocchedavarjitam
tryadhvavidakrtasankalpam akasabhedalaksanam
paramarthikam evedam pratyatmavedyalaksanam
sarvasv api kriyasv eva nisadyadisu yogavit
anakhyeyam anuccaryam tryadhvatitam japet sada
pandaradijapah proktah pancavimsacchatadvayam
caturbhir gunitam samyak caturyogam satam nava
navasatam tu yad drstam caturvimsatiparikramaih
pratyutpadad bhavet tac ca dvyayutam satasodasam
tad ittham guhyasandhyayam suksmayogam prakasitam
dhyanadhyayanavitam tu tathapi japa ucyate

vajrasisya uvaca | adhyatmikavagaksarapravrttikarane 'pagatasamsayah | api ca hrasvam samastavakyam syad ity uktam bhagavata tat katham hrasvo 'karah samastavakpravrtteh karanam bhavati

vajragurur aha | sadhu sadhu mahasattva | iha pravacanika vyakaranam puraskrtya kevalasabdarthamatram anusmaranti | na tu punar aksaram abhilapas ca kutra kasmat katham pravartata iti | yathabhutaksaratattvam na prajananti buddhagocaratvat | srnu desananusarena te pratibodhayami

sabdas tavad alikalimayah | ality akaradisodasasvarah | kaliti kakaradivarnas trayastrimsat | sodasasvarasamyuktam ekonapancasallipikam sarvam astavyastasamastasvaravyanjanabinduvisargasamhitadhatuvibhaktisamasapadavigrahastrilingatinantakrttaddhitapratyayadibhir bhasyaparyantam vyakaranam iti nama sanketakena paribhasanena jnayate | atas tasya padavakyacchandovrttaslokagathadandakadibhis caturasitisahasradharmaskandhasutrantatantrakalpatripitakakavyanatakadayo laukikalokottarasastrani sambhavanti | sastram asritya sarvasiddhayah sampadyante | yathoktam bhagavata lankavatarasutre
tadyatha mahamate kascid eva purusah pradipam grhya dhanam anvesayati | evam eva mahamate vagvikalparutapradipena bodhisattva mahasattva vagvikalparahitam svapratyatmagatim anupravisantiti
kintu tesam padavakyadigatavarnavisesanam vijnanabhuto 'yam akarah | yasmad akarasvaraviyukta na santi kakaradayo varnah | halantatvan na bhavanti vacyah | yathoktam bhagavata namasangitikayam
akarah sarvavarnagryo maharthah paramaksarah
mahaprano hy anutpado vagudaharavarjitah
sarvabhilapahetvagryah sarvavaksuprabhasvara iti
tenoktam bhagavata sakaladhyanamukhabijapadam | akaro mukham sarvadharmanam adyanutpannatvad iti | sahajaksaram tu punar ucyate | vajramandalalankaratantre 'py akaram dyotayann aha
jvalantam dipasadrsam hrdi madhyam anahatam
aksaram paramam suksmam akaram paramam prabhum iti

evam sarvatathagata akaranvayam akarahetubhutam akaranirjatam uccaritapradhvansisvabhavam vagvikalpalaksanam yatha- bhutam jnatva sabdapasabdanirapeksam sattvasayanusayabhedena vineyajanebhyo dharmam desayantiti
ata evoktam bhagavata lankavatarasutre

arthapratisaranena mahamate bodhisattvena mahasattvena bhavitavyam | na vyanjanapratisaranena | vyanjananusari mahamate kulaputro va kuladuhita va svam atmanam ca nasayati | paramartham ca param navabodhayati

tadyatha mahamate angulya kascit kasyacit kincid darsayet | sa capy angulyagram eva pratisared viksitum | evam eva mahamate balajatiya iva balaprthagjanavarga yatharutangulyagrabhinivesabhinivista evam kalam karisyanti | na yatharutangulyagrartham hitva paramartham anvesayanti
tasmad arthakamena te sevaniyah | ato viparita ye yatharutarthabhinivistas te varjaniya arthanvesineti
vakpravrttir api caturvidhety uktam bhagavata atraiva sutre

caturvidham mahamate vagvikalpalaksanam bhavati | yad uta laksanavak svapnavak dausthulyabhinivesavak | anadikalavikalpavak | tatra mahamate laksanavak svavikalparupanimittabhinivesat pravartate | svapnavak punar mahamate purvanubhutavisayanusmaranat pratinibaddhavisayabhavac ca pravartate | dausthulyavikalpabhinivesavak punar mahamate sattvapurvakrtakarmanusmaranat pravartate | anadikalavikalpavak punar mahamate anadikalaprapancabhinivesadausthulyasvabijavasanatah pravartate | etadd hi mahamate caturvidham vagvikalpalaksanam iti

anena nyayena sabdo 'karodbhavatvad aksarah | ksaram vinaso 'ksaram avinasah | khasamasvabhavam yac chabdadvarena pratipadyate | nispannakramam tad apy akrtakam anadinidhanasvabhavam iti | yathoktam ekanayanirdesasutre
dharma ime sabdarutena vyakrta dharmas ca sabdas ca hi natra labhyate
nayaikatam capy avatirya dharmatam anuttaram ksantivaram sprsisyata iti
yathoktam vairocanabhisambodhicaryatantre
api tu guhyakadhipate mantranam laksanam sarvabuddhair na krtam na karitam nanumoditam
tat kasya hetoh | esam dharmanam dharmata yad uta utpadad va tathagatanam anutpadad va tathagatanam sthitaivaisam dharmanam dharmata yad uta mantranam mantradharmata

tatra guhyakadhipate 'sti kamadhatvisvarasya madayantika nama vidya | taya sarvan kamavacaran devaputran madena murcchayati | vividhavicitraramaniyams ca pradesan darsayati | vividhavicitraparibhogams cabhinirmaya paranirmitavasavartibhyo devebhyah prayacchaty atmana ca paribhunkte

tadyathasti mahesvarasya devaputrasya manojava nama vidya | taya trisahasramahasahasre lokadhatau sarvakaryam karoti | sarvopabhogaparibhogams cabhinirmaya suddhavasakayikebhyo devebhyah prayacchaty atmana ca paribhunkte

tadyatha mahendrajaliko mantrair vividhavicitrarthan manusyadikan darsayati | tadyathapi nama mantrair mayam darsayati | tadyathapi nama mantrair visam apanayati jvaradikam ca | tadyathapi nama mantrakalpika devata mantraih sreyah sattvebhyah prayacchati | tadyathapi nama mantrair agner usnata nasyati sitata ca sambhavati

ebhir nidarsanapadair mantraprabhavo 'bhisraddhatavya iti | sa ca mantraprabhavo hi na mantrato niskramati | na sattvesu pravisati | na prayoktrta upalabhyate | atha ca kulaputra mantradhisthanadharmata sambhavam natikramati | kalatrayatitatvat | sarvathacintyapratityasamutpadabhinivartitatvac ca
tasmat tarhi kulaputracintyadharmatasvabhavagatingatena satatasamitam mantranayo 'nugantavya iti
evam adhyatmikabahyamanimantrausadhinam acintyaprabhavam agamadhigamabhyam pratipadya | idanim nispannanispannasattvadhatunam yathabhutavagvisuddhim darsayann aha | kinnararajapariprcchasutre
kutah punah kinnaradhipate sarvasattvanam rutaghosa niscaranti
aha | akasat kulaputra sarvasattvanam rutaghosa niscaranti
aha | na punah kinnaradhipate adhyatmikakosthat sarvasattvanam rutaghosa niscaranti
aha | tat kim manyase kulaputra kayabhyantarakosthat sarvasattvanam rutaghosa niscaranti | ahosvic cittat
aha | kinnaradhipate na kayan na cittat | tat kasmadd hetoh | kayo hi jado niscestas trnakudyakasthapratibhasopamah | cittam capy anidarsanam mayopamam apratigham avijnaptikam
aha | kayacittavinirmuktani punah kulaputra kuto 'nyato rutani niscaranti
aha | akasad amanaskarat sambhavati kinnaradhipate sarvasattvanam rutavijnaptih
aha | tat kim manyase kulaputra yady akasam na bhavet kuto rutani niscareyuh
aha | nakasavinirmuktah kinnaradhipate kascid rutaniscarah

aha | ) tad anena te kulaputra paryayenaivam veditavyam | ye kecid rutavyapara niscaranti | sarve te akasan niscarantiti | akasasvabhavani hi rutani samanantaraniryatani ca niruddhyante | niruddhani cakasasvabhavatayam eva santisthante

akasasvabhavah sarvadharmas te udahrta anudahrta va | tam evakasakotisamatam na vijahati | rutamatra hi kulaputra sarvadharma avijnaptivijnapaniyas te tu sanketena vyavahriyante | sa ca vyavaharo 'vyavaharah | yo hi rutasanketena vyavaharah sa na ca kvacid dharme 'bhinivisata iti

v: nanu prayojanavisesarthitaiva pumsah prayojanavisesasamsayotpattihetuh pragvidyata eva | tathahi prayojanavisesakanksaparigatamanasah prathamataramevam bhavatyeva, kimidamasmadadhi gataprayojanena saprayojanam ? ahosvidanyena ? kim va nisprayojanamiti; tatsadhaka badhakapramanabhave tasya nyayapraptatvat | prayojanavisesapratipadakasastrantaropala bdhesca | ato bhavatyeva pragapi prayojanavisesavisayasamsaya iti vyarthah prayojanavakyo panyasah | naitadasti | yadyapi prayojanavisesarthitapi samsayavisesaheturbhavati | ta thapi na sa sarvesam sammukhibhavati | avyutpannapurusarthanam mudhadhiyam kesamcidasammu khibhavat | tathahi—moksah paramapurusarthataya siddhah, atha ca santi kecidavyu tpanna ye tamapi paramapurusartham purusarthataya na jananti | pragye na tam prarthayisyante te | na va sammukhibhuta prayojanavisesakanksa prayojanavisesavisayasandehotpattihetu ryukta, karanasattadhinatvatkaryanam | yadi nama sa kesamcidapi sammukhibhavati, tathapyasau sadhanantaraparityagena pratiniyatasadhanopadanahetoh samsayavisesasya heturna bhavati; sarvatra sadhakabadhakapramanabhavena tasyastaddhetutvena nyayapraptatvat | na cai tavanmatrena pravrttiryukta | sarvatra pravrttiprasangat | na ca sakyam kenacitsarvatra pravartti tumityatah phalavisesarthino'pi pratiniyatasadhanaparigrahanibandhanabhavadudasiran | tasmatpratiniyatasadhanaparigrahahetuprayojanavisesavisayasamsayotpadanayatyantaparoksartha visayagamapranayanavat phalavisesarthina pratiniyatasadhanaparigrahayabhidhaniyameva prayo janavakyam | tatha hi tenasyaiva sastrasyarthavisesa upadarsyate nanyasya | ato'nena pratiniyatasadhanasadhyaphalavisesavisayah samsayo janyate | sa ca srota kadacinma mayamarthaviseso nispatsyata iti prayojanavakyopajanitat prayojanavisesavisayadatya ntaparoksarthavisayagamopajanitadiva samsayatpravarttetapityatah prayojanavakyopanyasah

avasyam caitadevam vijneyam, anyatha'tyantaparoksarthavisayagamapranayanamapi vyartham syat; pragapyagamapranayanaddanadisu phalavisesarthinam sadhakabadhakapramanabhavena ta tsamsayasya vidyamanatvat | kim tvasavavyutpannasvargadiphalanam naivotpadyate | tatkara nabhutayah phalavisesarthitaya asammukhibhavat | yesam copajayate tesamapi sarva tropaladibhaksane'pi pravrttihetutaya sadharanatvadupaladibhaksanapariharena (na) prati niyatadanadiparigrahaheturbhavatiti matva tadarthamagamapranetrbhiragamah praniyate tadvatprayo janavakyamapi sastrakarairityacodyametat | na capi jijnasitaprayojanavisesapratipadakam sastrantaramupalabdham, yena tadupalabdhibaladabhimataprayojanavisesavisayah sandeho bha vet | na hyabhimataprayojanavisesasadhane sastrantare sambhavati kascitpreksavan param sa strantaramarabhate | preksavattvahaniprasangat | ato na sastrantaropalabdhirapi vivaksi taprayojanavisesasandehaheturbhavati | tasmacchrotrjanapravrttyarthah prayojanadivakyopanyasa iti sthitam

yastu manyate na srotrjanapravrttyartham prayojanadikathanam, tatah samsayotpatteh; sam sayena tu preksavatah pravrttyasambhavat | kimtu yatprayojanarahitamanarthakam va tannarabdha vyam, yatha kakadantapariksonmattadivakyam; prayojanarahitam cedam sastramato na srotum karttum va prarabdhavyamityevam vyapakanupalabdhya yah pratyavatisthate tasya hetorasiddhatodbha vanarthamadau prayojanadivakyopanyasa iti | tadasamyagiva laksyate | samsayenapi pravrtteh prasadhitatvat | asiddhatodbhavanasya ca vaiyarthyat | evam hi tadarthavadbhavet | yadi tasya parasyato vakyatpravrttirbhavet | yavatodbhavitayamapyanena vakyenasiddha tayam nato vakyatpreksavato yathoktavyapakattatvaniscayah samutpadyate yenasau prava rttito bhavet | purvavadvakyasyasyapramanatvat | samsayena ca preksapurvakarino bhavanma tena pravrttyasambhavat | ato viphalamevasiddhatodbhavanam | napi kascitpreksavanavi ditasastrasariro'kasmadvyapakabhavam niscityanena pratyavatisthate | napi tatpratyavastha nat svayam viditasastraprayojano'pi sastrakrnnarabheta kartum srota va preksapurvakari nirnibandhanadvakyannivarttate yena tayoh pravrttyarthamasiddhatodbhavanam syat | athapi syadyo'preksapurvakari so'nibandhanamakasmadapi yathoktavyapakabhavam grhniyat | paraisca grahayedapi, atastam pratyasiddhatodbhavanam kriyata ityetadapyayuktam

v: evamabhidhaya prayojanam sakalaprakaranarthasamgrahakam slokamaha asadhananvacana 1b1 mityadina | asadhanangavacanamadosodbhavananca dvayorvadiprativadi noryathakramam nigrahasthanam parajayadhikaranam | anyattvityeta ddheyavyatiriktama ksapadapa rikalpitam pratijnasamnyasadikam vaksyamanam nigrahasthanam na yuktamiti krtva nesyate | nigrahasthanamiti varttate | ayam tavat sa masena slokarthah | istasye 1b1 tyadina vibhagamarabhate | isto'rtho'nittyah sabda ityadi sadhyattvenepsitah | tasya siddhih pratipattih sadhanam | tadanena bhavasya sadhanoyam sadhanasabdastavadasminvyakhyane'bhipreto na tu karanasadhana iti darsayati | tasya sadhanasyestarthasiddhilaksanamasyangam kintadityaha | nirvarttakam janakam | ane nangasabdam vyacaste | karanaparyayoyamatrangasabdo navayavaparyaya ityarthah | tacca sadhanangamiha niscitatrairupyam lingamucyate | asya sadhanangasya vacanam trirupalinga khyanam | tasya sadhanangasyavacanamanuccaranama 1b2 nabhidhanam yattadasadhanangavacanam | anenaitatkathayati asadhanangasya paksopanayana dervacanamasadhanangavacanamiti nai va pratipattavyamasminvyakhyane | kintu sadhananga syaivavacanamasadhanangavacanamiti | tadasadhanangavacanam vadino nigrahasthanam | tadetena slokasya purvvabhagamvivrnoti | kathampunah sadhanangasyanuccaranambhavati nigrahasthanam cetyaha | tadabhyupagamyeti 1b2 taditistam sadhyamabhyupagamyaha metatsadhayamiti pratijnayapratibhaya karana bhutaya tusnimbhavat | apratibha'tra purvvadhigatarthavismaranam stambhitattvanca grhyate

anena sarvvatha sadhanangasyavacanamaha abhidhane va yadi na samarthitam tadokta mapya' nuktameva svakaryakaranat | ityabhiprayavanaha — sadhanangasya samarthanadveti 1b2 | tadabhyupagamyetivartate | va sabdah purvvapeksaya vikalparthah | sadhana ngasyasamarthanam trisvapi rupesu niscayapradarsanam | tasmattu snimbhavadasamarthanacca sadhanangasyanuccaranam | tatasca pratijnatarthakaranat vadino nigrahadhikarana miti 1b2 prakrtena sambandhah | kvacittu vadina iti pathah | tatra tacchabdena prakrtamanuccaranam sambadhyate

kathampunah sadhanangasamarthanambha vati | yena tadviparyayenasamarthanatprati jnatarthakaranadvadino nigrahadhikaranattvamiti kadacitkascid bruyadityetatpari jihirsuradiprasthanamaracayati trividhameve 1b2 tyadina triprakarameva linga mangankaranam kasyasiddheh pratipattirupayah | kasya siddherityaha | apratya ksasya paroksasyanumeyabhutasya vastuna iti yavat | avadharanancaturadi vyavacchedamacaste | trividhameveti niyamah kathamayamiti cet | yasmadvidhi pratisedharupataya dvidha sadhyam vyavasthitam | vidhirupanca sadbha varupankaranaru pamva bhavad bhavet | nanyat | tatra hetoh pratibandhayogat | nahyarthantarasyaka ryasya sadbhave'parasya sadbhavo yuktah | patasadbhava ivostrasya | napyartham tarasyakaranasya nivrttavakaryasyanyasya ca nivrttiryuktimati | ustre nivrttaviva patasya | na canvayavyatirekavikalasyagamakattvam yuktam | patasyapyustragamakattva prasangat | svabhavabhutadharmasadbhave tu svabhavabhutasyanyasya sadbhavo yukto nahi svabhavah svambhavamparityajya vartte | tatsvabhavattvabhavaprasangat | tannivrttau ca nivr ttih | karyasyapi bhave karanasya bhavo yuktah | tannivrttau ca nivrttiranyatha tena vinapi bhavatkaryameva tattasya na syattadanyavat | tasmatsvabhava karanabhutasadhyabhedat | dvidhaiva vidhirupam sadhyam tatraiva hetoh pratibandhat | svabhavabhutanca sadhyam svabhavahetuh sadhayati | karanabhutanca karyahetu rityabhyupeyam | pratisedhamapyupalabdhilaksanapraptanupalabdhireva sadhayati | nanya yatha tatha vistarena pratipadayisyati | tadidamiha samksiptamartha tattvam visayavyapeksaya visayino limgasya vyavastha | visayasca vidhih pratisedho va bhavet | vidhavapyarthantaramva vidhiye tanarthantaram va arthantaravidhavapi ka ryakaranamanubhayamva sadhyate | karyapratipadanepi karanasamanyamva'meghadi vyavrttam vastumatram lingatvenocyate | karanaviseso va yo'prati baddhasamarthye me ghadih | pratisedhopi nisedhyabhimatasyanupalambhenopalambhena va pratipadyeta | anupalambhepi upalambhanivrttimatralaksano va bhavet | tattulyayogavastha h kevala parapadarthopalambharupo veti vikalpah | tatra navasyam gambhiradhvanadiyuktamapi meghadikaranamatram vrstyadikaryavirbhavaka mantara pratibandhasambhavena vya bhicarat | ato na karanamatram gamakam | karana visesadapyapratihatasakteranantaram sambandhasmrtivyavahitadanumeyavijnanatprak karyamevodbhutamaksajnanagrahyam bhavatiti na tasyapi lingatvam | karyantu karana lingam yuktam | tadavinabhavat | tadatikrame va hetumattamvilamghayet | anubhayamapya sambandhanugamakamatiprasango va | anarthantaramapyavyabhicarangamyata iti yukti mat | nisedhopyupalambhena na yujyate virodhat | katham hi namopalabhyate ca nasti cetyupapadyate | tajjnana nivrttimatramapi vyabhicari | ekajnanasamsarginastu kaivalya drsterasattavyavaharo yukto yadi hi syadupalabhya sattva eva bhavet | pramananca yada nupapadya manavisayam na tadvisayi yuktam | yatha vajivisanam | anupapadyamanavisaya ncoktaprakarena svabhavadi syadanyasamyogyadiparaparikalpitam lim gamiti vyapa kanupalambhah | vaidharmyena niladijnanam | tadeva va karyadilingam | naimittikasabda rthanupapattirbadhika | kimevam siddhamagamakattvamanyesam | tathahi visa yitvanga makattvam prakasakattvamityadayah paryayah | tasmatsadhyasya trividhattvattangamako heturapi trividha eveti sthitametat

purnnam karoti bhavana (!) sahasava (!) sarvvam tan sarvval o ka jan ani (!) pranamami bhaktya
evam maya srutam ekasmin samaye bhagavan kosambyam mahanagaryam viharati sma kantakasa [
mjn ] ke mahavanavare ghosiralame mahata mahabhiksusaghena sardham pa ncamatrair bhiksusataih sabahu
lais ca mahasra vakair asamkhyayas (!) ca bodhisatvair mmahasatvaih sarvabuddhasamanvagataih

idam avocad bhagavan attamana ayusman anandas te ca bhiksavas te ca bodhisatva
mahasattva sa ca sarvavati parsat sadevamanusasuraga ndharvaloko bhagavato bhasitam abhyanandann iti

v: prajnaparamitahrdayasutram | [samksiptamatrka] (847c8)摩訶般若波罗蜜大明咒经
namah sarvajnaya (9)姚秦天竺三藏鳩摩罗什譯

evam maya srutam | ekasmin samaye bhagavan rajagrhe viharati sma grdhrakute parvate mahata bhiksusamghena sardham mahata ca bodhisattvasamghena | tena khalu samayena bhagavan gambhiravasambodham nama samadhim samapannah (7)如是我闻。一時佛在王舍大城灵鷲山中。與(8)大比丘众满百千人。菩萨摩訶萨七萬七千(9)人倶。其名曰观世音菩萨。文殊师利菩萨。弥(10)勒菩萨等。以爲上首。皆得三昧总持。
aryavalokitesvarabodhisattvo gambhirayam prajnaparamitayam caryam caramano vyavalokayati sma | panca skandhah, tams ca svabhavasunyan pasyati sma (10)观世音菩萨。行深般若波罗蜜時。照見五陰(11)空。度一切苦厄。
athayusman sariputro buddhanubhavena aryavalokitesvaram bodhisattvam etad avocat 詣世尊所。面向合掌曲躬恭敬。(14)瞻仰尊顏而白佛言。

yah kascit kulaputro [va kuladuhita va asyam] gambhirayam prajnaparamitayam caryam cartukamah, katham siksitavyah? evam ukte aryavalokitesvaro bodhisattvo mahasattvah ayusmantam sariputram etad avocat 世尊。我欲於此会中。説(15)诸菩萨普遍智藏般若波罗蜜多心。唯愿世(16)尊聽我所説。爲诸菩萨宣秘法要。爾時世尊(17)以妙梵音。告观自在菩萨摩訶萨言。
iha sariputra rupam sunyata, sunyataiva rupam 善哉善(18)哉具大悲者。聽汝所説。與诸众生作大光明。(19)於是观自在菩萨摩訶萨蒙佛聽許。佛所护(20)念。入於慧光三昧正受。入此定已。以三昧力(21)行深般若波罗蜜多時。照見五蘊自性皆空。(22)彼了知五蘊自性皆空。從彼三昧安詳而起。(23)即告慧命舍利弗言。
evam eva vedanasamjnasamskaravijnanani 受想行識亦(15)如是。
iham sariputra sarvadharmah sunyatalaksana anutpanna aniruddha amala na vimala nona na paripurnah 舍利弗是诸法空相。不生不灭。不垢不(16)净。不増不減。是空法。非過去非未來非現在。
na vidya navidya na vidyaksayo navidyaksayo yavanna jaramaranam na jaramaranaksayo na duhkhasamudayanirodhamarga na jnanam na praptitvam (19)无无明亦无无明盡。乃至无老死无老死盡。(20)无苦集灭道。无智亦无得。以无所得故。
bodhisattvasya(s ca?) prajnaparamitam asritya viharati cittavaranah 菩萨(21)依般若波罗蜜故。心无罣碍。
tasmaj jnatavyah prajnaparamitamahamantro mahavidyamantro ’nuttaramantro ’samasamamantrah sarvaduhkhaprasamanah satyam amithyatvat 故知般若波罗蜜是大明咒。无上明咒。(25)无等等明咒。能除一切苦眞實不虚故説般
atha khalu bhagavan tasmat samadher vyutthaya aryavalokitesvarasya bodhisattvasya sadhukaram adat - sadhu sadhu kulaputra 即時世尊從(24)广大甚深三摩地起。讃观自在菩萨摩訶萨(25)言。善哉善哉。
tadyatha om gate gate paragate parasamgate bodhi svaha (29)摩訶般若波罗蜜大明咒经
tadyatha om gate gate paragate parasamgate bodhi svaha | iti prajnaparamitahrdayam samaptam 即说咒曰:揭諦揭諦 波罗揭諦 波罗僧揭諦 菩提萨婆訶。般若波罗蜜多心经。

namah tritatavinyasa- sivasaktisamanvite | grahavetalayaksosma- nasini pravare ture 敬礼具三真實母 善靜威力皆具足 药叉執魅尾怛辣 都哩最極除灾禍
mantramulam idam stotram namaskaraikavimsakam | yah pathet prasannadhiman devyam bhaktisamanvitah 若有智者勤精進 至心诵此二十一 救度尊處誠信礼 是故赞嘆根本咒

abhisikto bhavet turnam saptabhir jinakotibhih | asmin mahattvam apadya so 'nte bauddhapadam vrajet 此等速能得聰慧 七俱胝佛所灌顶 現世富貴寿延安 當來趣向诸佛位

v: nirvikalpapravesadharani (敦煌本入无分別总持经)
1v1)(... evam maya srutam ekasmin sa)maye bhagavan rajagrhe virahati sma
tatra khalu bhagava(3)(n anekasatasahasraya parsada parivrtah puraskrto) dharmam desayati sma | yad uta dharmanam nirvikalpatam arabhya (1r1)(...)上首(...)世尊,百千众会前後圍繞,猶依诸法无分別而顯於法。
atha tasyam eva parsady avikalpaprabhaso nama bodhisattvo mahasattvah 爾時无分別照明菩萨摩訶萨,在大众中,
bhagavams tesam etad avocat 爾時世尊告诸菩萨摩訶萨言:
tasya tani kramaso vikalpanimittani parivarjayatah 彼便次第能捨分別诸相,
tasya tani pari(2)(varjayatah tadanyani tattvanirupanavikalpani)mittani samudacaranty amukhibhavanty abhasagamanayogena 彼能遍遣彼想之時,有餘真實之想,現前而行。
tasya tany api parivarjayato ’parani praptinirupanavikalpanimittani samudacaranty amukhibhavanty abhasagamanayogena 彼若遣除如是诸想之時,有餘證得分別之想,分明顯現、現前(35)而行。
evam sa bodhisattvo mahasattva etani sarvakaravikalpanimittany amanasikaratah parivarjayan suprayukto bhavaty avikalpena 菩萨摩訶萨於如是等诸分別想,由不作意而能捨之,是名於无分別而勤學也。
kena karanena kulaputra avikalpadhatur avikalpa ity ucyate 何故「无分別界」名「无分別」耶?
katarat tad avikalpam 何者无分別?

tad yatha kulaputra ekaghanasaramayasya pasanaparvatasyadhastan mahananaratnaparipurnanidhih syad ( | ) bhasuranam vicitranam mahacintamaniratnanam | yad uta rupyaratnasya va | suvarnaratnasya va | (3)(asmagarbhananaratnasya va 善男子!譬如有一胜妙石藏之下,而有種種雜宝光色燦爛異常。所謂金、銀、琉璃、赤珠等(60)诸雜宝藏。
tatha hi kulaputra iyam upama kr)ta yavad evasyarthasya vijnaptaye 作是語已,善男子,為了彼义而作此喻。
katham punah kulaputra bodhisattvo mahasattva etani yathanirdistani vikalpanimittani vyupapari(3r1)(ksamano ’vikalpadhatum pravisati 復次,善男子!如何菩萨摩訶萨以賴观察分別相故而能趣入无分別界耶?
iha kulaputrah bodhisattvo mahasattvah sarvakarajnatanirupanavikalpanimitta amukhibhuta evam vyupapariksate 善男子!此中菩萨摩​​訶萨,於一切種智上,起於如是分別。

asya kulaputra dharmaparyayasya udgrahanalekhanavacanad bahutaram punyam nanv eva ganganadivalukopamatmabhavaparityagasya nanv eva gamganadivalukopamalokadhatuparipurnaratnadanasya nanv eva gamganadivalukopamalpkadhatuparipurnatathagatabimbakarapanapunyaskandhasyeti 善男子,若有受持此经章句,書寫讀诵,所生胜福,甚極广大,非舍恒沙身命以為校量,亦非舍恒沙世界满中珍宝、亦非供养满於恒沙世界一切如來宝像塔廟所生之福。
atha khalu bhagavams tasyam velayam ime gathe abhasata 爾時世尊,而说頌曰:

idam avocad bahgavan attamana avikalpaprabhasas ca bodhisattvo mahasattvah sa ca sarvavati parsat sadevamanusasuragandharvas ca loko bhagavato bhasitam abhyanandann iti 爾時世尊,说此经已,无分別照明菩萨摩訶萨,(133)及诸大会,闻佛所说,皆大欢喜,信受奉行。

v: 4 om namah sarvajnaya | namo bhagavate bhaisajyaguruvaiduryaprabharajaya tathagataya (401a04)药师如來本愿功德经序 (401a05)药师如來本愿经者,致福消灾之要法也;曼殊以慈悲之力請说尊號,如來以利物之心盛陳功业;十二大愿彰因行之弘遠,七宝庄严顯果德之純净;憶念稱名則众苦咸脫,祈請供养則诸愿皆满;至於病士求救應死更生,王者攘灾轉禍為福;信是消百怪之神符,除九橫之妙術矣。(401a11)昔宋孝武之世,鹿野寺沙门慧簡已曾譯出在世流行,但以梵宋不融、文辞雜糅,致令轉讀之輩多生疑惑。矩早學梵書恒披叶典,思遇此经验其紕謬;开皇十七年初獲一本,猶恐脫誤未敢即翻,至大业十一年復得二本,更相讎比方為揩定,遂與三藏法师達磨笈多,并大隋翻经沙门法行明則、長順海馭等,於東都洛水南上林園翻经舘重譯此本。深鑑前非方懲後失,故一言出口必三覆乃書,傳度幽旨差无大過;其年十二月八日翻勘方了,仍為一卷。(401a21)所愿此经深义人人共解,彼佛名號處處遍闻,十二夜叉念佛恩而护国,七千眷屬承经力以利民,帝祚遐永,群生安樂,式貽來世序云爾。 佛说药师如來本愿经 (401a26)新翻药师经,大业十二年十二月八日,沙门慧矩等六人,於東都洛水南上林園譯出。此本最定,诸讀诵者愿莫更疑,得罪不輕。

bhi ca le ca le bi ca le ma bi
lamba hu mu hu mu svaha gsan ba pai bdag

pa thams cad dan ne bar 'dug nas de dag
gis smras pa hum hum si si svaha de skad
bar bgyi'o dus ma lags par 'gum pa las bzlog
par bgyi'o tadyatha sve te sve te sve ta le
li li 'phags skyes pos kyan smras pa ma tam

v: kyan bcos nas gtan la phab pa de bzhin gsegs
pa dgra bcom pa yan dag par rjogs pai sans
rgyas sakya thub pa la phyag 'chal lo tadyatha om
mu ni mu ni maha mu na ye svaha lan
cig ka la ka la ki li ki li bi
ri bi ri hu ru hu ru bai ro ca
na ra smi sanco di te a gaccha arya a
ka sa garbha maha ka ru ni ka pu ra
ya ha sa na dha ra ya buddhe bisca ya
na ca ra ca ra ci ri ci ri svaha
bton pas 'grub ste mchon cha dan me dan bcom
pa yan dag par rjogs pai sans rgyas sman gyi
bla bai durya od kyi rgyal po la phyag 'chal
lo om bhai sa jye bhai sa jye maha bhai
sa jye bhai sa jya ra sa mutga te svaha
de bzhin gsegs pa sman gyi blai snin poi gzuns
rjogs so

v: na la se a na la sam bha be a
na la sa ga tim ga te svaha de bzhin
gsegs pa sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba
la phyag 'chal lo tadyatha he ma he ma ha
ma ha ma svaha de bzhin gsegs pa od dpag
med la phyag 'chal lo tadyatha a mi totbha be
a mi ta sam bha be a mi ta bi
krante a mi ta bi kranti ka re a mi
ta ga ga na kirti ka re svaha de bzhin
gsegs pa yon tan 'byun gnas la phyag 'chal lo
tadyatha ga ga na a ka ra ga ga na
sam bha be ga ga na kirti ka re svaha
de bzhin gsegs pa kun nas spos mchog la phyag
'chal lo tadyatha sa ma sa me svaha de bzhin
gsegs pa gzhan gyis mi thub pai rgyal mchan gyis
'brug bsgrags gsegs pa la phyag 'chal lo tadyatha a
sa ma sa me svaha de bzhin

v: legs so rigs kyi bu dei phyir snin po gan
brjod pa cam gyis mchams med pa lna 'byan zhin
dnos grub thams cad kyan thob par 'gyur ba byan
chub sems dpa' brgyad kyi snin po non cig om
maha hum maha bi ra svaha snin po 'dis ni
dbus kyi bcom ldan 'das mchod do om hri hum
padma pri ya svaha 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dban
phyug gi snin po'o om mai ha ra na svaha
byams pai snin po'o om a ka sa garbha ya
svaha nam mkhai snin poi snin po'o om sva hri
ra ja ya svaha kun du bzan poi snin po'o
om ku ru bha na ra ha svaha lag na
rdo rjei snin po'o om sri am ram ga svaha
'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pai snin po'o om ni

ta tha ga ta ya arha te samyaksam bud dha
ya tadyatha om a ji te a ji te a
pa ra ji te a ji tan ja ya ha
ra ha ra mai tri a ba lo ki te
ka ra ka ra maha sa ma ya siddhe bha
ra bha ra maha bodhi manda bi je sma ra
sma ra a sma kam sa ma ya bodhi bodhi
maha bodhi svaha rca bai gsan snags so om mo
hi mo hi maha mo hi svaha snin po'o om
mu ni mu ni sma ra svaha ne bai snin

kha ton byed pa dan chul bzhin yid la pa

bde ba nid du dus byed par 'gyur ro om

phyag 'chal lo namo ratna tra ya ya namo bha
ga ba te dharma dha tu ni garji ta ra

bud dha ya namo manju sri ye ku ma ra

nucche da ya ba ra laksa na a lam kr
ta sa ri ri bodhi sa tva si su pa
ti pa la ya bud dha na de sa ya
de ba na ga yaksa ga na dharba a su

ye svaha om sa me sa me maha sa me

sa ma ne svaha na mahsu pa ri kirti ta
na madhe ya ya sri ye ta tha ga ta
ya na mahsa mantra va bha sa bi ji ta
sam gra ma sri ye ta tha ga ta ya
ka la buddha dharma pa ri pu ra nae ya
svaha namo ratna tra ya ya namo arya ba lo
ki te sva ra ya bodhi satva ya maha satva
ya maha ka ru ni ka ya namo ma hastha
ma brapta ya bodhi satva ya maha satva ya maha
ka ru ni ka ya e bhyo nam skri tva
i da marya ba lo ki te sva ra mu

ta tha ga ta sam mu kham bhu si tam
ma ha tam parsanmadhye a ha mi da ni ma
barta yisya mi siddhyantu me mantra pa dahsarva karya ni

pai de bzhin gsegs pa thams cad la phyag 'chal

rje chen po dan ldan pa 'phags pa spyan ras

sa maha da na pa ra mi ta pa ri

bi ci traih sarva satva u pa bho ga sarva

ya ta ra ta ra ta ra ya maha padma

dantu mam sa manta bha dra dharani svaha gzuns 'di
thos ma thag tu byan chub sems dpa' bye ba
phrag dgu bcu rca gnis po de dag gis dpa'
bar 'gro bai tin ne 'jin thob par gyur to

maha ka ru ni ka ya tadyatha ti li ban
dha mi mi li ban dha mi ci li mi
li ban dha mi si mi ban dha mi bdag
gi mchams las su yan 'da' bar ma gyur cig
svaha chu la lan ni su rca gcig yons su
bzlas te phyogs bcur bha ga ba na arya a
ba lo ki te sva ra ya svaha 'di ni
bdag gi snin po bsad pa ste des bdag 'gugs

bho maha siddha yo gi sva ra bha na bha
na ba ca na sa dha ya sa dha ya
bi dya na sma ra sma ra tvam bha ga
pam tam lo ka nu pi lo ki tam tathagata
tam de hi de hi me darsa na ka ma
sya darsa nam pra sa dha ya me svaha siddha
ya svaha maha siddha ya svaha siddha yo gi sva
ra ya svaha ni la kantha ya svaha ba ra
ha mu kha ya svaha sin ha mu kha ya
svaha maha na ra sin ha mu kha ya svaha
vajra ha sta ya svaha maha vajra ha sta ya
svaha siddhi bidya dha ra ya svaha maha siddha bidya
dha ra ya svaha padma ha sta ya svaha maha
padma ha sta ya svaha krsna sarva kr ta ya
jno dha ra bi ta ya svaha maha ma la
mu ku ta dha ra ya svaha cakra yu dha
dha ra ya svaha sadkha sabda nirna da na ka
ra ya svaha bo dha na ka ra ya svaha
ba ma sthi ta kandha de sa krsna ji na
ya svaha

kanthai gzuns rjogs so rgya gar skad du arya a
ba lo ki te sva ra ha ya gri ba
dharani bod skad du 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs ku
be ra a su rendra ma tr ga na na

ya gri ba pra hma pa ra ma hrdaya ma
brta yisya mi a ba pra me yarha sa dha

nam bi sa nanca bi na ya kam tadyatha om

a pa ya durga ti pra sa ma ka sarva

phyag 'chal lo om namo bha ga ba te bi

arha te samyaksam buddha ya namo bha ga ba te

mu la mantram om sarva tathagata bya ba lo ki
te ja ya ja ya svaha hr da yam om
hu ru hu ru ja ya mu khe svaha u

dan bcas pa rnams la phyag 'chal lo tadyatha om
ja ya ka ri yuddhotta ra ni bi ci tra
mu khi sarva manga la dha ra ni ji mu

ni ka kho rda ni ba ra ni om hi

sya ti tadyatha buddha phuddha bi buddha bi buddha ma

cchinda na ga hri da ya ni bhindha bhindha na

na ni tadyatha hum phat na ga bi da ra
na ya phat na gotsa da na ya phat ni
lam pa sa na ya phat a pra ti ha

v: arya vajra a ji ta a na la pra mo
ha ni nama dharani bod skad du 'phags pa rdo
rje mi pham pa me ltar rab tu rmons byed
ces bya bai gzuns sans rgyas dan byan chub sems
dpa' thams cad la phyag 'chal lo 'di skad na
pra ha ra na ma ya siddha da yi ge
su ru ke su ru ke vajra gho ne vajra
ddhi sa ra pra ha ra ne ratna tra ya
di kra la buddhe te vajra dha ra bi sva
sa ni ka a pra ti ha ta pra marda
ni svaha gan gsan snags 'di rjes su dran nas
klog gam sgom mam 'jin

v: bram zei khyeu des chans pai skad phyun ste rdo
rjei chig 'di lha gnas gsum por bsgrags so rdo
rje phra mo thogs pa med pa zhes bya bai
gzuns rjogs rgya gar skad du arya vajra bhai ra
ba dharani nama bod maha ba la a gri he
ha ha vajra vajra ha ye dha ra dha ra
hum hum manda la sa ma pa ra a kra
bi kra me ku ru ku ru tu ru tu
ru sarvam tha sarva hi jva la jva la a
kri ni phat svaha rig snags dan gsan snags thams
cad kyi snin po 'di de bzhin gsegs pai spyan
snar lan ston nid kyan 'dar bar 'gyur 'byun po
kun gyis ma smad pa de ni srun bar byed
pai mchog ji ltar lhar bcas 'jig rten na sans
rgyas 'dra bai ston pa med bden pai chig ni
de yis ni skye bo kun la bsrun gyur cig
tadyatha om vajra pra ka ra vajra

v: ldan 'das dan lag na rdo rjei zhabs la gtugs
nas gsan snags bsad pa namo ratna tra ya ya
nam scanda vajra pa na ye maha yaksa se na
pa ta ye namo vajra kro dha ya pra jva
li ta di pta dam stotka ta bha ya bhai
ra ba ya a si mu sa la vajra pa
ra su pa sa ha sta ya tadyatha om hu
lu hu lu a mr ta kunda li ni kha
kha kha kha kha na kha na kha da kha
da kha hi kha hi kha hi kha hi tistha
tistha ha na ha na da ha da ha pa
ca pa ca grhna grhna bandha bandha garja garja tarja
tarja bi sno ta ya bi sno ta ya bha
ga ba na a mr ta kunda li murdha na
ta da ya vajre ni sarva bighnan pi na ya
ka na ni ba ra ya maha ga na pa
ti ja bi tanta ka ra ya hum phat phat
phat

dan 'jog po nag pos zhabs gdub byas pa chans

gnod sbyin dan sa za dan 'byun po thams cad
ha hi hum zhes brjod pas skrag par byed pa
ham mam gsan snags smras pa na mahsa manta arya
ca la nam tra ta tra ta amogha canda maha
ro sa na spho ta ya spho ta ya hum

ba la ba la ma ra ma ra ma ra

ldan pa 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dban phyug la
phyag 'chal lo gsan snags kyi gzhi 'di dag grub

li ci li ci li ci li ci li ci

v: byan chub sems dpa' rnams la phyag 'chal lo brtul
zhugs grub pa rnams la phyag 'chal lo sems can
gyi sman pa rnams la phyag 'chal lo nor bu
grub pa rnams la phyag 'chal lo 'di lta ste
namo ratna tra ya ya om ye dharma he tupra
bha ba he tu na te sam ta bu kha
zas la bdun nam ni su bzlas nas kyan khon
du btan na phan par 'gyur de yi bzlas brjod
sna ma ste 'di dag rab tu bzlas bar bya
namo ratna tra ya ya om ye nharma he tu
pra bha ba he tu na tae ni ta tha
ga to hya ba data te sa nca ya na
ratna am gi van la ni snags bzlas nas snin
po stobs chen 'di bris gdags om vajra krodha maha
ba la ha na da ha pa ca bi dhvansa
ya ja ti lom bhodhara ucchusma krodha hum phat svaha
gcan sbra byas te mgul par gdags de bzhin yuns
kar dag la yan bzlas

v: suddhe ma na si a bhyarci ta bra tisthi ta
na na namo bha ga ba te a mr ta
a yu sa sya tathagata sya om sarva tathagata suddhe
a yu ra bi sodha ni sam ha ra sam
ha ra sarva tathagata birya ba len pra ti sam
ha ra a yuhsa ra sa ra sarva tathagata sa
ma ya bodhi bodhi buddhya buddhya bo dha ya bo
dha ya ma ma sarva pa ba a ba ra
na bi suddhe bi ga ta ma lam char su
buddhe buddhe hu ru hu ru svaha 'di ni rca
bai snags te gan la la 'dii cho ga byed
par 'dod na ches brgyad dan bcu gsum dan bcu
bzhi dan bco lna rnams gan yan par mi nus
te gsan snags thams cad kyi rca ba yin pai
phyir ro yan mchod rten dei srog sin gi gsan
snags bsad pa om sarva tathagata bi bu la yasti
mani ka na ka ra ja ta bi bu si
ta yasti dhu ru dhu ru sa manhe bi lo
ki te sa ra sa ra ma ma

v: rnams che ni zlog par byed lhai dban po gzuns
snags bstan gyis non cig na mahsarva ta tha ga
ta nam om maha cinta mani jva la na sa
gar ga mbhi re a karsa ya a karsa ya
a yundha ra a yundha ra sandha ra sandha ra
ksa na ksa na ksi ni ksi ni ksu nu
ksu nu sarva tathagata maha sa ma ya tistha tistha
maha bhu ba na sa ga ra sam so dha
ya mam sarva satvam sca bha ga ba ti sarva
pa pam bi ma la ja ya ja ya ja
ya labdhe sphu ta sphu ta spho ta ya spho
ta ya bi ga ta a ba ra ni bha
ya ha ra ni hum hum hum mr tyu da
nda dha re a bha ya pra de usnisa bya
ba lo ki te sa manta mu khe sa manta
bya ba lo ki ga tosni sa bi lo ki
te svaha sarva tathagata guhya a dhissa na adhisthi te
svaha a yurda de svaha punyad de svaha punya pi
lo ki te sva ham punya a ba lo ki
te svaha mr tyudande svaha yam dande svaha ya ma
du te svaha sam ha ra ni svaha sam bha
ra ni svaha sandha ra ni svaha pra tis

v: gsol de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis lhai dban po
brgya byin gyis gsol ba btab pa mkhyen nas gzuns
'di dag bka' scal to om namo bhagavate sarva trai
lo kya pra ti bisasti ya buddha ya te namah
tadyatha om bhrum bhrum bhrum sodha ya sodha ya bi
sodha ya sa bhu mi bra tisthi te sarva ta
tha ga ta hrdaya a dhi ssa na a dhi
sthi te mu dre mu dre maha mu dre vajra
ka ya sam ha ti na pa ri suddhe sarva
karma a va ra na bi suddhe pra ti ni
brta ya ma ma a yu ra bi suddhe sarva
ta tha ga ta sa ma ya a dhistha na
a dhi sthi te om mu spha ra ya spha
ra ya sarva buddha a dhi stha na a dhi
sthi te suddhe suddhe buddhe buddhe vajre vajre maha vajre
su vajre vajra garbhe ja ya garbhe bi ja ya
garbhe vajra jva la garbhe vajra ud bha be vajra
sam bha be vajre vajri ni

v: padmai spyan dan zla od dan phyag rgyai chogs de
dag thams cad kyis bdag la bsrun du gsol bsrun
ba mjad du gsol om r si ga na pra
sasta ya sarva ta tha ga tosni sa si ta
ta pa tre hum dhum jambha na ka ri hum
drum stambhan ka ni hum drum maha bidya sa ma
bhaksa na ka ri hum drum bar bidya sam bha
ksa na kari hum drum sarva dusta nam gtambha na
ka ri hum drum sarva yaksa ra ksa sa gra
ha ni bi dhva nsa na ka ri hum drum
ca tu ra si ti nam gra ha sa ha
sva ni bi dhvansa na ka ri hum drum asta
bim ga ti nam na ksa tra nam pra sa

la lan gsum snags na rims las thar bar 'gyur
ro namo ratna tra ya ya na ma arya ba
lo ki te sva ra ya bodhi sa tva ya
maha sa tva ya tadyatha ci li ci li mi

lnai skud paam skud pa dmar po la lan gsum

du byas pa la padma rgyas pai sten du lha
ni ma bsam par bya ba ni lus gzi brjid
kyi phun po li khri ne bar 'bar ba lta
bu ni ma ston dan mchuns bai od zer can
no om mai gholka ya svaha sar du zla ba

su mig dmar po om raktam ga ku ma ra

mdog ser po om bu dha ya svaha bden bral

po om a su rotta ma ya svaha rlun du

v: ni bdag gi rims nad son sig ma 'dug sig
svaha bden pa dan bden pai chig gan gis 'jig
rten na sans rgyas bla na med pa dan 'jig
rten na chos dan dge 'dun bla na med pai
bden pa dan bden pai chig des bdag gi rims
nad son ma 'dug sig svaha sidhyantu mantra pa dai
ta ra tu bidya tam bra hma a nu mo
te svaha skud pa nag po la lan ni su
rca gcig bzlas te mdud pa ni su rca gcig
dor ro

v: 'di brjod do namo ratna tra ya ya namo manju
na tha ya namo ya manta ka ya tadyatha om
manju bha ra manju gho sa ha na ha na
ha na da ha da ha pa ca pa ca
be ce be ce bhi ta bhi ta i phu
ta i phu ta he ra te sotta ni na
mahsotta ni pri pi sa le tan pri ta ha
sa pra bhi na ta ja ya hum hum hum
hum he ra te sotta ni hum phat svaha om
pa gi sva ri mum manju gho sa ha na
ba ti si dho ha ri ni svaha snags de
lan cig brjod pas mi des chei gzuns dkon mchog
gsum la phyag 'chal lo om ba ga ba ce
jam bha ni stom bha ni mo ha ni sarva
ro sa pra sa ma ni svaha sar phyogs su
bltas te 'dug la snags 'di brjod cin ran gi
lag pas lan bdun gdon la

brjod byas na bcins pa las grol bar byed do
bcins pa las grol bai gzuns rjogs rgya gar skad
du a gra bidya mantra bod skad ta nam tadyatha
om sadkhi ni de bi a gaccha a gaccha tissa
dha ne dha na ja ye bri bri brddhri ka
ri dhri dhri dhr ti ka ri na na bi
bidya be sa bsta a yurdha ra ni yu yu
a yuspa la ni ta tha ga ta smrar bodhi
citta ma ti lam bo da ra de hi me
ba ra na sadkhi ni svaha bdag dge ba 'di
nid kyis sprul pai sku 'di nid du mthon bar
gyur cig ston pa nid la bzod pa thob par
gyur cig ston ba nid kyi don mthon bar gyur

v: bcom ldan 'das sems can ses rab rtul po blo
zhan pa yid mi gzhuns pa rnams kyi slad du
ses rab skyed pa zhes bgyi bai gzuns bsad du
gsol bsad pa hum pi cu pi cu prajna bardha
ni jva la jva la me dha bardha ni dhi
ri dhi ri buddhi bardha ni svaha gan zhig gzuns
'di 'jin pa dan klog pa dan 'dri ba dan
'drir 'jug pa dan chun nu na yi ge 'bru

v: prajna bardha ni nama dharani bod skad du ses rab
skyed pa zhes bya bai gzuns namo ratna tra ya
ya na ma arya ba lo ki te sva ra
ya bodhi satva ya maha sa tva ya maha ka
ru ni ka ya tadyatha om bi ba bi ba
prajna bartta ni ja ra ja ra me dha bardha
ni dhi ri dhi ri bu ddhi bardha ni svaha
rig snags 'dii cho ga ni 'di yin te nan
re zhin rca ba mo khyor gan la lan ni
su rca gcig bzlas te zla ba gcig gi bar
du 'thuns na thos pa 'jin bar tha smr ti
ma ti ma ti te jo bidya hu ru me
hu ru hu ru me krsna hu ru me svaha
su dag nag po la snags 'di lan brgya rca
brgyad bzlas brjod byas te zos na gdon mi za
bar thos pa 'jin par 'gyur ro thos pa 'jin
pai gzuns

pa ta ma ta ma ta svaha glog 'bar ba
rab tu phyun zhin rji char chen poi rgyun thon
la char phob cig kye kye klu chen po dag
sans rgyas kyi bden pa dan chos kyi bden pa
dan dge 'dun gyi bden pa dran par gyis sig
kye klu chen po dag chur seg chur seg 'jam
bui glin du char rab tu phob sig gu tu
gu tu mu du mu du hi hi hi hi
cu da cu da maha na ga hrd ya sarva
na ga nam a kaddha ya sanco da ya sri
ghan da ra svaha sprin chen po dag chur chur
chur seg chur seg dhu dhu dhu dhu ha ha
ha hi hi hum hum 'brug sgra chen po sgrogs
sin rlun chen po rab tu gton ba dag sans
rgyas kyi bden pas 'jam bui glin 'dir char rab

v: atha vaksye mantrakosam yad uktam bhutadamare / kramad bijavidhanam ca srutyarthajnanasambhavam // 1

srisiva uvaca / a vidyujjihva a kalavajri i garjini i dhumrabhairavi u kalaratrih u vidari r maharaudri r bhayamkari l samharini lu karalini e urdhvakesi ai ugrabhairavi o bhimaksi au dakini am rudrarakini ah candika ka krodhisah kha vamanah ga candah gha vikari na unmattabhairavah ca jvalamukhah cha raktadamstrah ja asitangah jha vadavamukhah ja vidyunmukhah ta mahajvalah tha kapali da bhisanah dha ruruh na samhari ta bhairavah tha dandi da balibhuk dha ugrasuladhrk na simhanadi pa kapardi pha karalagnih ba bhayamkarah bha bahurupi ma mahakalah ya jivatma ra ksatajoksitah la balabhedi va raktapatah sa candisah sa jvalanadhvajah sa dhumadhvajah ha vyomavaktrah ksa tryailokyagrasanatmakah // 2

candisah ksatajarudho dhumrabhairavyalamkrtah / nadabindusamayukto bijam visnupriya matam srim // 5
ksatajastho vyomavaktro dhumrabhairavyalamkrtah / nadabindusamayukto bijam prathamikam smrtam hrim // 6
krodhisah ksatajarudho dhumrabhairavyalamkrtah / nadabindusamayuktah pitrbhuvasini smrtah krim // 7
vidariyuktam vyomasyam rudrarakinyalamkrtam / kurcam kalam krodhabijam janihi viravandite hum // 8
nadabindusamayuktam samadayograbhairavim / bhautikam vagbhavam bijam viddhi sarasvatam priye ai // 9

v: prajnaparamita-hrdaya-sutra om namo bhagavatyai arya-prajaparamitayai! arya avalokitesvaro bodhisattvo gambhiram prajnaparamita-caryam caramano vyavalokayati
sma, panca-skandhas tams ca svabhava-sunyan pasyati sma. iha sariputra rupam sunyata, sunyat'aiva
rupam, rupan na prthak sunyata, sunyataya na prthag rupam, yad rupam sa
sunyata, ya sunyata tad rupam. evam eva vedana-samjna-samskara-vijnanam. iha sariputra sarva-dharmah sunyata-laksana
anutpanna aniruddha amala avimala anuna aparipurnah. tasmac chariputra sunyatayam na rupam na
vedana na samjna na samskarah na vijnanam, na caksuh-srotra-ghrana-jihva-kaya-manamsi, na rupa-sabda-gandha-rasa-sprastavya-dharmah, na
caksur-dhatur yavan na mano-vijnana-dhatuh, n'avidya n'avidya-ksayo yavan na jara-maranam na jara-marana-ksayo na
duhkha-samudaya-nirodha-marga na jnanam na praptir n'apraptih. tasmac chariputra apraptitvad bodhisattvo prajna-paramitam asritya
viharaty acitt'avaranah. citt'avarana-nastitvad atrasto viparyas'atikranto nistha-nirvanah. tradhva-vyavasthitah sarva-buddhah prajnaparamitam asritya anuttaram samyak-sambodhim
abhisambuddhah. tasmaj jnatavyam prajnaparamita maha-mantro maha-vidya-mantro'nuttara-mantro samasama-mantrah sarva-duhkha-prasamanah satyam amithyatvat. prajnaparamitayam ukto
mantrah, tadyatha - om gate gate paragate parasamgate bodhi svaha. ity arya-prajnaparamita-hrdayam
samaptam

v: aparimitayuh sutra evam maya srutam / ekasmin samaye bhagavan sravastyam viharatisma jetavane
anathapindadasyarame mahata bhiksusanghena sardham ardhatrayodasarbhibhiksusataih sambahulaisca bodhisattvairmahasattvaih
tatra khalu bhagavan manjusriyam kumarabhutam amantrayate sma / asti manjusriruparistayam aparimitagunasancayo nama
lokadhatustatraparimitayurjnanasuviniscitatejoraja nama tathagato 'rhan samyaksambuddha eva hi tisthati dhriyate yapayati sattvanam ca
dharmam desayati
srnu manjusrih kumarabhuta, ime jambudvipaka manusya alpayuska varsasatayusas, tesam bahunyakalamaranani nirdistani /
ye khalu manjusrih sattvastasyaparimitayusah tathagatasya gunavarnaparikirtana nama dharmaparyayam likhisyanti likhapayisyanti namadheyamatram api
srosyanti yavat pustakagatam api krtva grhe dharayisyanti vacayisyanti puspadhupagandhamalyavilepanacurnacivarachatradhvajaghantapatakabhisca samantat pujabhih pujayisyanti
te pariksinayusah punaraiva varsasatayuso bhavisyanti / ye khalu punarmanjusrih sattvastasyaparimitayurjnanasuviniscita tejorajasya tathagatasya
namostottarasatam srosyanti dharayisyanti vacayisyanti, tesam ayurvadhayisyanti, ye pariksinayusah sattva namadheyam srosyanti dharayisyanti
vacayisyanti tesam apyayurvivardhayisyati
tasmattarhi manjusridirghayuskatvam prarthayitukamah kulaputra va kuladuhitaro va tasyaparimitayusastathagatasya namastottarasatam srosyanti likhisyanti tesam ime gunanusamsa bhavisyanti
om namo bhagavate aparimitayurjnanasuviniscitatejorajaya tathagatayarhate samyaksambuddhaya, tadyatha, om punyamahapunya aparimitapunya aparimitayupunya jnanasambharopacite,
om sarvasamskara parisuddhadharmate gaganasamudgate svabhavaparisuddhe mahanayaparivare svaha
imam manjusristathagatasya namostottarasatam ye kecil likhisyanti likhapayisyanti pustakagatam api krtva grhe dharayisyanti
vacayisyanti, te pariksinayusah punaraiva varsasatayuso bhavisyanti, itascutva aparimitayusastathagatasya buddhaksetre upapadyante, aparimitayusasca bhavisyanti
aparimitagunasancaye lokadhatau
om namo bhagavate / tena khalu punah samayena navanavatinam buddhakotinam ekamatenaikasvarena idam aparimitayuh sutram bhasitam
om namo bhagavate / tena khalu punah samayena caturasitinam buddhakotinam ekamatenaikasvarena idam aparimitayuh sutram bhasitam
om namo bhagavate / tena khalu punah samayena saptasaptatinam buddhakotinam ekamatenaikasvarena idam aparimitayuh sutram bhasitam
om namo bhagavate / tena khalu punah samayena pancasastinam buddhakotinam ekamatenaikasvarena idam aparimitayuh sutram bhasitam
om namo bhagavate / tena khalu punah samayena pancapancasatinam buddhakotinam ekamatenaikasvarena idam aparimitayuh sutram bhasitam
om namo bhagavate / tena khalu punah samayena pancacatvarisatinam buddhakotinam ekamatenaikasvarena idam aparimitayuh sutram bhasitam
om namo bhagavate / tena khalu punah samayena sattrimsatinam buddhakotinam ekamatenaikasvarena idam aparimitayuh sutram bhasitam
om namo bhagavate / tena khalu punah samayena pancavimsatinam buddhakotinam ekamatenaikasvarena idam aparimitayuh sutram bhasitam
om namo bhagavate / tena khalu punah samayena ganganadivalukopamanam buddhakotinam ekamatenaikasvarena idam aparimitayuh sutram bhasitam
om namo bhagavate / ya idam aparimitayuh sutram likhisyati likhapayisyati sa na
kadacinnarakesupapadyate na tiryagyonau na yamaloke na aksanesu ca kadacid api upapasyate /
yatra yatra janmanyupapadyate, tatra tatra sarvatra jatau jatau jatismaro bhavisyanti
om namo bhagavate / ya idam aparimitayuh sutram likhisyati likhapayisyati tena caturasitidharmaskandhasahasrani likhapitani bhavisyanti
om namo bhagavate / ya idam aparimitayuh sutram likhisyati likhapayisyati tena caturasitidharmarajikasahasrani karapitani pratisthapitani bhavisyanti
om namo bhagavate / ya idam aparimitayuh sutram likhisyati likhapayisyati tasya pancanantaryani karmavaranani pariksayam gacchanti
om namo bhagavate / ya idam aparimitayuh sutram likhisyati likhapayisyati, tasya na
maro na marakayika na yaksa na raksasa nakalamrtyurevataram lapsyante
om namo bhagavate / ya idam aparimitayuh sutram likhisyati likhapayisyati, tasya maranakalasamaye
navanavatayo buddhakotyah sammukham darsanam dasyanti, buddhasahasram hastena hastam tasyopanamayanti, buddhaksetradbuddhaksetram sankramati, natra
kanksa na vicikitsa na vimatirutpadayitavya
om namo bhagavate / ya idam aparimitayuh sutram likhisyati likhapayisyati, tasya catvaro maharajanah prsthatah prsthatah samanubaddha raksavaranaguptim karisyanti
om namo bhagavate / ya idam aparimitayuh sutram likhisyati likhapayisyati sa sukhavatyam lokadhatau amitabhasya tathagatasya buddhaksetre upapadyate
om namo bhagavate / ya idam aparimitayuh sutram likhisyati likhapayisyati, sa prthivipradesah
caityabhuto vandaniyasca bhavisyati / yesam tiryagyonigatanam mrgapaksinam karnapute nipatisyati te sarve anuttarayam
samyak sambodhau abhisambodhim abhisambhotsyante
om namo bhagavate / ya idam aparimitayuh sutram likhisyati likhapayisyati tasya stribhavo na kadacid api bhavisyati
om namo bhagavate / ya idam aparimitayuh sutram dharmaparyayam uddisya ekam api
karsapanam danam dasyati, tena trisahasramahasahasralokadhatum saptaratnaparipurnam krtva danam dattam bhavati
om namo bhagavate / ya idam dharmabhanakam pujayisyati, tena sakalasamaptah saddharmah pujito bhavati
om namo bhagavate / yatha vipasvisikhivisvabhukrakucchandakanakamunikasyapasakyamuniprabhrtinam tathagatanam saptaratnamayah pujah krtva tasya punyaskandhasya
pramanam sakyam ganayitum, na tvaparimitayuh sutrasya punyaskandhasya pramanam sakyam ganayitum
om namo bhagavate / yatha sumeroh parvatarajasya samanam ratnarasim krtva danam dadyat,
tasya punyaskandhasya pramanam sakyam ganayitum, na tvaparimitayuh sutrasya punyaskandhasya pramanam sakyam ganayitum
om namo bhagavate / yatha catvaro mahasamudra udakaparipunna bhaveyuh, tatra ekaikavindum sakyam
ganayitum, na tvaparimitayuh sutrasya punyaskandhasya pramanam sakyam ganayitum
om namo bhagavate / ya idam aparimitayuh sutram likhisyati likhapayisyati samskrtya pujayisyati
tena dasasu diksu sarvabuddhaksetresu sarvatathagata vanditah pujitasca bhavisyanti
om namo bhagavate / danabalena samudgata buddho danabaladhigata narasimhah / danabalasya ca sruyati sabda karunikasya pure pravisantam
silabalena samudgata buddho silabaladhigata narasimhah / silabalasya ca sruyati sabda karunikasya pure pravisantam
ksantibalena samudgata buddho ksantibaladhigata narasimhah / ksantibalasya ca sruyati sabda karunikasya pure pravisantam
viryabalena samudgata buddho viryabaladhigata narasimhah / viryabalasya ca sruyati sabda karunikasya pure pravisantam
dhyanabalena samudgata buddho dhyanabaladhigata narasimhah / dhyanabalasya ca sruyati sabda karunikasya pure pravisantam
prajnabalena samudgata buddho prajnabaladhigata narasimhah / prajnabalasya ca sruyati sabda karunikasya pure pravisantam
om namo bhagavate / idam vocadbhagavan attamanaste ca bhiksavaste ca bodhisattva mahasattvah
sa ca sarvavati parsat sadevamanusasuragandharvasca loko bhagavato bhasitamabhyanandanam iti

evam maya srutamekasamaye bhagavan sukhavatyam viharati sma mahata bodhisattvasamghena sardham - tadyatha
avalokitesvarena ca bodhisattvena mahasattvena mahasthamapraptena ca bodhisattvena mahasattvena sarvanivaranaviskambhina ca bodhisattvena mahasattvena
ksitigarbhena ca bodhisattvena mahasattvena samantabhadrena ca bodhisattvena mahasattvena akasagarbhena ca bodhisattvena mahasattvena
vajrapanina ca bodhisattvena mahasattvena sarvabhayaharena ca bodhisattvena mahasattvena evam sarvamangaladharina ca bodhisattvena
mahasattvena sarvapunyalaksanadharina ca bodhisattvena mahasattvena candrasuryatrailokyadharina ca bodhisattvena mahasattvena sarvatirthamangaladharina ca bodhisattvena
mahasattvena mamjusriya ca kumarabhutena ca bodhisattvena mahasattvena evampramukhairbodhisattvairmahasattvaih / ( smdv 94
) atha khalvaryavalokitesvaro bodhisattvo mahasattvo yena bhagavamstenopasamkrantah / upasamkramya bhagavatah padau sirasabhivandyaikante
nyasidat / srirapi mahadevi bhagavantamevopasamkranta / upasamkramya bhagavatah padau satasahasram pradaksinikrtya sarvamsca
tan sukhavatinivasino bodhisattvan mahasattvan sirasabhivandyaikante nyasidat / atha khalu bhagavananekasatasahasrapunyalamkrtastathagatakotiparivrtah sarvasakrabrahmalokapalastutastavitah sriyam
mahadevim drsta mahabrahmasvarenavalokitesvaram bodhisattvam mahasattvametadavocat / yah kascidavalokitesvara raja va rajamatro va
bhiksubhiksunyupasakopasika va brahmanaksatriyavitsudra va sriya mahadevya astottaram satam vimalaprakhyam nama stotram dharayisyanti
tasya rajnah ksatriyasya visaye tesam sattvanam sarvabhayetyupadrava prasamisyanti / sarvacoradhurtamanusyamanusyabhayam na bhavisyati
/ sarvadhanadhanyakosakosthagaravivrddhirbhavisyati / tasya ca rajnah ksatriyasya grhe srirnivasisyati / atha te
bodhisattva mahasattva evam vacamabhasanta / sadhu sadhu ( smdv 95 ) bhagavan
subhasiteyam vak / ye sriya mahadevya namadheyani dharayisyanti tesamapima gunanusamsa bhavisyanti /
atharyavalokitesvaro bodhisattvo mahasattvo bhagavantametadavocat / kutra bhagavan sriya mahadevya kusalamulamavaropitam / bhagavanaha
/ gamganadivalukasamanam tathagatanamantikat sriya mahadevya kusalamulamavaropitam / bhutapurvamavalokitesvara atite 'dhvani ratnasambhavayam lokadhatau

/ imani ca tathagatanamani tasyah sriya mahadevyah kusalamulavivrddhisampattikarani / sadanubaddhanitani sriya mahadevya

aupabhogikah samsarasya naimittikah prajamandalasyotpadikah / ye ca kulaputrah sadaksarim mahavidyarajnim janante, na

malam, evameva kulaputra yasya sadaksari mahavidya kayagata, na tasya kayena na ragena
na dvesena na mohena samlipyate

samcintya vyavasthitah / tato akase chando (sabdo?) niscarati sma - dadasva arya
sadaksarim mahavidyarajnim / ayam bodhisattvabhuto 'nekaduskarabhiyuktah / punah sa dharmabhanakah samcintayati sma
- kutah sabdo niscarati / tatah sa punarapyakasacchabdo niscaritah - dadasvartha sadaksarim
mahavidyarajnim / ayam bodhisattvo 'nekaduskarabhiyuktah
atha sa dharmabhanaka akasam vyavalokayati sma / yavatpasyati saratkandagauravarnam jatamukutadharam sarvajnasirasikrtam subhapadmahastam
padmasriyalamkrtam sariram / sa tadrsam rupam drstva sarvanivaranaviskambhinam bodhisattvametadavocat - anujnataste kulaputra
avalokitesvarena bodhisattvena sadaksarim mahavidyarajnim
atha sa dharmabhanakastasyaitadavocat - ekasyaksarasyapi na bhavati daksina, prageva sadaksarimahavidyayah / na

vaineyasca tvam kulaputra / tena tasya satasahasramulyamuktaharamupanamitam / sa kathayati - kulaputra,
madvacanena sakyamunestathagatasyarhatah samyaksambuddhasyopanamayitavyam
iti sadaksarimahavidyamandalavarnanam sastham prakaranam
om cale cule cunye svaha

- kim karanam tvam kulaputra tusnimbhavena vyavasthitah? atha mahesvaro devaputrastametadavocat - dadasva
me vyakaranamanuttarayam samyaksambodhau / avalokitesvarastametadavocat - bhavisyasi tvam kulaputra vivrtayam lokadhatau bhasmesvaro

parimocaya me stribhavajjugupsaniyat / kalimalaparipurnagarbhavasaduhkhat satataparigrahasamgrhitat parimoksaya mam / athavalokitesvarastametadavocat - bhavisyasi
tvam bhagini umesvaro nama tathagato 'rhan samyaksambuddho vidyacaranasampannah sugato lokavidanuttarah purusadamyasarathih sasta
devanam ca manusyanam ca buddho bhagavan / himavatah parvatarajasya daksine parsve tava
lokadhaturbhavisyati / atha sa umadevi vyakaranamanuprapta
